timeline.text_zh:
Arbitrum已作为紧急安全措施暂停新的Stylus激活。此外，一项新的BoLD防护机制若接受相互矛盾的证明，可能会延迟尚未确认的提款。

此次暂停使新的Stylus合约无法在Arbitrum上激活，而现有合约仍可继续运行和续期；同时BoLD防护机制引入了一条新路径，可能使等待确认的提款被延迟。

现有活跃合约仍可继续运行和续期。此次行动中没有用户资金损失的报道。
timeline.text_en: Arbitrum paused new Stylus activations as an emergency security measure, while a new BoLD guard could delay unconfirmed withdrawals if contradictory proofs are accepted.

threads.title_zh: Core Lightning 建议节点运营者因未修补漏洞下线
threads.title_en: Core Lightning Advises Node Operators to Go Offline Over Unpatched Vulnerability
threads.summary_zh: 攻击者正积极针对未修补的 Core Lightning 节点；运行 26.06.7 或更早版本的操作者被敦促立即升级，此前关于验证 Docker 镜像摘要的指示仍然适用。
threads.summary_en: Attackers are actively targeting unpatched Core Lightning nodes; operators on version 26.06.7 or earlier are urged to upgrade immediately, and prior instructions to verify Docker image digests remain relevant.
threads.latest_update_zh: Core Lightning 收到攻击者正积极针对未修补节点发起攻击的报告，并敦促运行 26.06.7 或更早版本的操作者立即升级至最新版本。
threads.latest_update_en: Core Lightning received reports of attackers actively targeting unpatched nodes and urged operators running version 26.06.7 or earlier to upgrade to the latest release immediately.
threads.background_zh: Core Lightning（CLN）开发者已告知节点运营者让其节点下线，因为存在一个严重且尚未修补的漏洞。修复后的二进制文件尚未发布，细节目前处于两周的保密期（embargo）内。
threads.background_en: Core Lightning (CLN) developers have told node operators to take their nodes offline because of a critical unpatched vulnerability. The fixed binaries have not yet been released, and details are under a two-week embargo.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Core Lightning urged node operators on version 26.06.7 or earlier to upgrade immediately after receiving reports that attackers are actively targeting unpatched nodes.
threads.latest_summary_en: Core Lightning urged node operators on version 26.06.7 or earlier to upgrade immediately after receiving reports that attackers are actively targeting unpatched nodes.

timeline.text_zh: Core Lightning 收到攻击者正积极针对未修补节点发起攻击的报告，并敦促运行 26.06.7 或更早版本的操作者立即升级至最新版本。
timeline.text_en: Core Lightning received reports of attackers actively targeting unpatched nodes and urged operators running version 26.06.7 or earlier to upgrade to the latest release immediately.

timeline.text_zh: 披露 Kubernetes 构建错误导致四个 Docker 标签分发了未修补的二进制文件，即使启动时显示为 v26.06.7，要求运营商验证镜像摘要并更换受影响的镜像。
timeline.text_en: Disclosed a Docker build error distributing unpatched binaries under four tags that reported v26.06.7 at startup, requiring operators to verify image digests and replace affected images.

timeline.text_zh: Core Lightning 建议节点运营者因未修补漏洞下线
timeline.text_en: Core Lightning Advises Node Operators to Go Offline Over Unpatched Vulnerability

threads.title_zh: Zano 在 Gateway Address 漏洞利用后回滚区块链一个月
threads.title_en: Zano rolls blockchain back a month after Gateway Address exploit
threads.summary_zh: Zano 已确认 Gateway Address 漏洞被利用铸造 3690 万枚未授权 ZANO 及 fUSD，并已回滚约一个月链上历史；恢复工作将主要通过交易所和支付服务执行，交易所将回放被回滚撤销的提款，团队将贷记受影响的存款。
threads.summary_en: Zano has confirmed the Gateway Address exploit minted 36.9M unauthorized ZANO plus fUSD and has rolled back about a month of chain history; recovery is now being carried out primarily through exchanges and payment services, with exchanges to replay withdrawals reversed by the rollback and the team crediting affected deposits.
threads.latest_update_zh: Zano 发布事后分析，披露攻击者通过 Gateway Address 漏洞在 8 月 29 日和 9 月 25 日分别铸造约 1840 万枚 ZANO，共 3690 万枚未授权 ZANO 及 fUSD；攻击者支付 100 ZANO 注册费并先行测试伪造资产，首次铸造近一个月未被发现。恢复将主要通过交易所和支付服务进行，交易所将回放被回滚撤销的提款，团队将贷记受影响的存款。
threads.latest_update_en: Zano's post-mortem revealed the attacker exploited the Gateway Address vulnerability to mint about 18.4M ZANO on Aug. 29 and another 18.4M on Sept. 25, totaling 36.9M unauthorized ZANO plus fUSD; the attacker paid a 100 ZANO registration fee, tested a fabricated asset first, and the first mint went unnoticed for nearly a month. Recovery will primarily run through exchanges and payment services, with exchanges to replay withdrawals reversed by the rollback and the team crediting affected deposits.
threads.background_zh: Zano 是一条以隐私为核心的加密货币，fUSD（Freedom Dollar）是在 Zano 上发行的去中心化、锚定美元的稳定币，其官方说明称该协议没有管理员密钥或黑名单功能。据相关事件报道，该网络从区块 3,833,000 重新启动，删除了约 30 天的链上数据，并推送了热修复，团队称更新后的链运行稳定。Zano 周三表示，正使用开发者基金、团队成员个人资金以及已承诺的捐款来恢复受影响的余额，主要通过与交易所和支付服务商的协作进行：交易所将重放被回滚撤销的提现，团队则为受影响的充值记账。
threads.background_en: Zano is a privacy-focused cryptocurrency, and fUSD (Freedom Dollar) is a decentralized, dollar-pegged stablecoin issued on Zano that its documentation describes as having no admin keys or blacklist function. According to reports on the incident, the network was restarted from block 3,833,000, removing roughly 30 days of blockchain data, and a hotfix was pushed with the team saying the network is stable on the updated chain. Zano said Wednesday it is working to restore affected balances using its developer fund, team members' personal funds and committed contributions, primarily through exchanges and payment services, with exchanges replaying withdrawals reversed by the rollback and the team crediting affected deposits.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Zano's post-mortem revealed an attacker exploited its Gateway Address vulnerability to mint 36.9 million unauthorized ZANO and fUSD tokens, which were indistinguishable from legitimate coins and ultimately forced the team to roll the blockchain back by a month.
threads.latest_summary_en: Zano's post-mortem revealed an attacker exploited its Gateway Address vulnerability to mint 36.9 million unauthorized ZANO and fUSD tokens, which were indistinguishable from legitimate coins and ultimately forced the team to roll the blockchain back by a month.
threads.discussion_zh: 此次漏洞直接冲击 ZANO 与 fUSD 的供应完整性，风险传导路径主要经由已上线或托管这些代币的交易所与支付服务商——它们需要重新对账被回滚撤销的提现与充值——以及持有 fUSD、其余额取决于重启后链上状态的用户。由于 Zano 属于较小市值网络，影响主要集中在该生态的流动性以及市场对隐私币和稳定币协议安全的情绪，而非更广泛的市场结构。
threads.discussion_en: The exploit directly hits the supply integrity of ZANO and fUSD, so exposure runs through exchanges and payment services that listed or custody the tokens and must now reconcile withdrawals and deposits reversed by the rollback, plus fUSD holders whose balances depend on the restarted chain state. Because Zano is a smaller-cap network, the transmission is concentrated in that ecosystem's liquidity and in sentiment toward privacy-coin and stablecoin protocol security rather than broader market structure.
threads.market_impact_zh: 此次漏洞直接冲击 ZANO 与 fUSD 的供应完整性，风险传导路径主要经由已上线或托管这些代币的交易所与支付服务商——它们需要重新对账被回滚撤销的提现与充值——以及持有 fUSD、其余额取决于重启后链上状态的用户。由于 Zano 属于较小市值网络，影响主要集中在该生态的流动性以及市场对隐私币和稳定币协议安全的情绪，而非更广泛的市场结构。
threads.market_impact_en: The exploit directly hits the supply integrity of ZANO and fUSD, so exposure runs through exchanges and payment services that listed or custody the tokens and must now reconcile withdrawals and deposits reversed by the rollback, plus fUSD holders whose balances depend on the restarted chain state. Because Zano is a smaller-cap network, the transmission is concentrated in that ecosystem's liquidity and in sentiment toward privacy-coin and stablecoin protocol security rather than broader market structure.

timeline.text_zh: 在 Gateway Address 漏洞利用导致未经授权的 ZANO 和 Freedom Dollar 进入流通后，Zano 在区块 3,833,000 处重启区块链——就在硬分叉 6 之前——回滚了约一个月的历史记录，并使该期间内的合法交易失效。
timeline.text_en: Following a Gateway Address exploit that let unauthorized ZANO and Freedom Dollar enter circulation, Zano restarted its blockchain at block 3,833,000 — just before Hard Fork 6 — rolling back about a month of history and invalidating legitimate transactions from that period.

threads.title_zh: Aave 提议设立法律实体以将协议知识产权置于 DAO 治理之下
threads.title_en: Aave Proposes Legal Entity to Place Protocol IP Under DAO Governance
threads.summary_zh: Aave 提议设立一个专门的法律实体，代表其 DAO 持有该协议的知识产权，这是 DeFi 最大借贷协议之一的结构性治理变更。
threads.summary_en: Aave has proposed establishing a dedicated legal entity to hold the protocol's intellectual property on behalf of its DAO, a structural governance change for one of DeFi's largest lending protocols.
threads.latest_update_zh: Aave 提议设立一个专门的法律实体，代表其 DAO 持有该协议的知识产权，这是 DeFi 最大借贷协议之一的结构性治理变更。
threads.latest_update_en: Aave has proposed establishing a dedicated legal entity to hold the protocol's intellectual property on behalf of its DAO, a structural governance change for one of DeFi's largest lending protocols.
threads.background_zh: Aave 是一个非托管的 DeFi 借贷协议，利率由供需算法决定，是规模最大的去中心化借贷协议之一。基金会等法律载体被普遍用于让 DAO 持有和保护商标、域名等知识产权，并与链下世界互动，同时协议仍由链上治理运行。
threads.background_en: Aave is a non-custodial DeFi lending protocol where interest rates are set algorithmically by supply and demand, and it is among the largest decentralized lending protocols. Legal wrappers such as foundations are commonly used so that a DAO can hold and protect intellectual property like trademarks and domain names and interact with the off-chain world, while on-chain governance continues to run the protocol.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Aave has proposed establishing a dedicated legal entity to hold the protocol's intellectual property on behalf of its DAO, a structural governance change for one of DeFi's largest lending protocols.
threads.latest_summary_en: Aave has proposed establishing a dedicated legal entity to hold the protocol's intellectual property on behalf of its DAO, a structural governance change for one of DeFi's largest lending protocols.
threads.discussion_zh: 该提案涉及 Aave 品牌与代码库的法律所有权，而非协议流动性，因此市场传导路径主要在治理与法律结构层面：提案声明 AAVE 持有者的现有投票权不变，而更清晰的法律载体可能影响交易对手、贡献者与机构参与者同协议互动的方式。ARFC 阶段本身不会改变抵押资产、上币安排或代币供应。
threads.discussion_en: The proposal concerns the legal ownership of Aave's brand and codebase rather than protocol liquidity, so any market transmission runs through governance and legal structure: AAVE holders' existing voting rights are stated as unchanged, while a clearer legal wrapper could affect how counterparties, contributors and institutional participants engage with the protocol. The ARFC stage itself does not alter collateral, listings or token supply.
threads.market_impact_zh: 该提案涉及 Aave 品牌与代码库的法律所有权，而非协议流动性，因此市场传导路径主要在治理与法律结构层面：提案声明 AAVE 持有者的现有投票权不变，而更清晰的法律载体可能影响交易对手、贡献者与机构参与者同协议互动的方式。ARFC 阶段本身不会改变抵押资产、上币安排或代币供应。

The ARFC stage itself does not alter collateral, listings or token supply.

threads.title_zh: Supabase将收购Turso
threads.title_en: Supabase is acquiring Turso
threads.summary_zh: Supabase 宣布收购 Turso，理由是为 AI Agent 提供可即时按需创建的独立数据库；两家产品暂不合并，Turso 数据库继续开源，计划逐步打通（小任务用 Turso，规模变大后迁移到 Supabase 的 Postgres），Turso 创始人 Glauber Costa 将加入 Supabase 负责 Agent 服务，收购金额未公布。
threads.summary_en: Supabase announced it is acquiring Turso to give every AI agent an instantly provisioned database; the products remain separate for now (Turso Database stays open source), with gradual integration planned (small agent tasks on Turso, scaling into Supabase's Postgres), Turso founder Glauber Costa joining Supabase to lead agent-related services, and the deal value undisclosed.
threads.latest_update_zh: 补充收购细节：收购意在服务 AI Agent（Supabase 每周新建超 100 万个数据库，约 70% 来自 Agent/AI 工具），Turso 的 Rust 版 SQLite 架构可单机管理数百万按需数据库；两家产品暂不合并（Supabase 继续做 Postgres，Turso 继续做 SQLite，现有数据库/API/工作流不变，Turso Database 继续开源），计划逐步打通；Turso 创始人 Glauber Costa 将加入 Supabase 负责 Agent 相关服务；收购金额未披露。
threads.latest_update_en: Added deal details: the acquisition targets AI-agent workloads (Supabase says over 1M databases are created weekly, ~70% from agents/AI tools), Turso's Rust SQLite architecture can manage millions of on-demand databases per server; the products will not be merged immediately (Supabase stays on Postgres, Turso stays on SQLite, existing databases/APIs/workflows unchanged, Turso Database remains open source) with gradual integration planned; Turso founder Glauber Costa will join Supabase to lead agent-related services; deal value undisclosed.
threads.background_zh: Supabase announced it is acquiring Turso, the company behind the libSQL/Turso SQLite-compatible database, prompting community debate about Turso's technical future, performance problems, and open-source self-hosting options.
threads.background_en: Supabase announced it is acquiring Turso, the company behind the libSQL/Turso SQLite-compatible database, prompting community debate about Turso's technical future, performance problems, and open-source self-hosting options.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Supabase acquired database company Turso, whose Rust-based SQLite implementation can spin up millions of on-demand cloud databases per server, to give every AI agent its own instantly provisioned database, with the two products kept separate for now (Supabase on Postgres, Turso on SQLite, still open source) and gradual integration planned.
threads.latest_summary_en: Supabase acquired database company Turso, whose Rust-based SQLite implementation can spin up millions of on-demand cloud databases per server, to give every AI agent its own instantly provisioned database, with the two products kept separate for now (Supabase on Postgres, Turso on SQLite, still open source) and gradual integration planned.

threads.title_zh: IMF批准向萨尔瓦多拨款并豁免比特币违规
threads.title_en: IMF Approves Disbursement to El Salvador and Waives Bitcoin Breach
threads.summary_zh: IMF批准向萨尔瓦多拨付1.38亿美元，此前已接受比特币豁免，但仍期望该国停止在已记录捐赠之外的进一步BTC购买，并完全清退剩余的Chivo敞口。
threads.summary_en: The IMF approved a $138 million disbursement for El Salvador after accepting a Bitcoin waiver, while still expecting the country to halt further BTC purchases beyond documented donations and fully unwind its remaining Chivo exposure.
threads.latest_update_zh: 萨尔瓦多承诺不再进行超出已记录捐赠范围的比特币积累，并继续降低政府在比特币相关活动中的参与度，同时加强透明度披露及监管框架建设。
threads.latest_update_en: El Salvador committed to stop accumulating BTC beyond recorded donations and to reduce government involvement in Bitcoin-related activities, with continued transparency and regulatory framework improvements.
threads.background_zh: The IMF approved a $139 million disbursement to El Salvador under its $1.4 billion Extended Fund Facility and granted a waiver for the country's breach of program conditions limiting further bitcoin purchases.
threads.background_en: The IMF approved a $139 million disbursement to El Salvador under its $1.4 billion Extended Fund Facility and granted a waiver for the country's breach of program conditions limiting further bitcoin purchases.
threads.latest_summary_zh: The IMF approved a $138 million disbursement to El Salvador under its $1.4 billion EFF program after granting a waiver on Bitcoin accumulation limits, with El Salvador committing to stop accumulating BTC beyond recorded donations and to reduce government involvement in Bitcoin-related activities.
threads.latest_summary_en: The IMF approved a $138 million disbursement to El Salvador under its $1.4 billion EFF program after granting a waiver on Bitcoin accumulation limits, with El Salvador committing to stop accumulating BTC beyond recorded donations and to reduce government involvement in Bitcoin-related activities.

timeline.text_zh: 萨尔瓦多承诺不再进行超出已记录捐赠范围的比特币积累，并继续降低政府在比特币相关活动中的参与度，同时加强透明度披露及监管框架建设。
timeline.text_en: El Salvador committed to stop accumulating BTC beyond recorded donations and to reduce government involvement in Bitcoin-related activities, with continued transparency and regulatory framework improvements.

timeline.text_zh: IMF批准根据其14亿美元扩展基金机制向萨尔瓦多拨付1.39亿美元，并就该国违反限制进一步购买比特币的计划条件给予豁免。
timeline.text_en: The IMF approved a $139 million disbursement to El Salvador under its $1.4 billion Extended Fund Facility and granted a waiver for the country's breach of program conditions limiting further bitcoin purchases.

threads.summary_en: Meta has open-sourced the Muse Gadgets SDK (ESP32 and Linux, Apache 2.0) and launched the Muse Home Link hardware hub, enabling developers to build Muse-connected devices.
threads.latest_update_zh: Meta开源了Muse Gadgets SDK，包括ESP32固件和Linux SDK（Apache 2.0协议），并推出Muse Home Link USB-C集线器（首批5000台，美国Muse订阅用户免费，10月发货）以连接智能家居设备。

threads.title_zh: 华尔街监管机构就投资顾问加密资产托管规则提出提案
threads.title_en: Wall Street regulator proposes rules on investment adviser crypto asset custody
threads.summary_zh: SEC 于2026年10月1日提出的投资顾问加密资产托管规则仍处于提案阶段，新增细节显示该框架覆盖注册投资顾问和受监管基金，并允许特定条件下的自托管；评论期待定，所有条款在最终规则前不生效。
threads.summary_en: The SEC's Oct. 1, 2026 proposed investment adviser crypto custody rules remain at proposal stage; added details show the framework covers registered investment advisers and regulated funds, permits self-custody under conditions, and has a pending comment period; all provisions are conditional until a final rule.
threads.latest_update_zh: 新报道补充了 SEC 10月1日提案的具体内容：为注册投资顾问和受监管基金设立加密资产托管框架，允许在特定条件下自托管，并承认州信托公司可作为托管人；评论期60天，条款须待最终规则生效。
threads.latest_update_en: New report details the SEC's Oct. 1 proposal: creates a crypto custody framework for registered investment advisers and regulated funds, allows self-custody under certain conditions, recognizes state trust companies as custodians, and sets a 60-day comment period; provisions remain conditional until a final rule.
threads.background_zh: The SEC proposed new rules governing how investment advisers must custody crypto assets, a step that would formalize compliance obligations for firms offering digital-asset exposure to clients.
threads.background_en: The SEC proposed new rules governing how investment advisers must custody crypto assets, a step that would formalize compliance obligations for firms offering digital-asset exposure to clients.
threads.latest_summary_zh: The SEC proposed a crypto custody framework allowing investment advisers and regulated funds to hold digital assets, the ninth US agency crypto action since Aug. 18, even as Congress leaves the SEC-CFTC jurisdictional boundary unresolved.
threads.latest_summary_en: The SEC proposed a crypto custody framework allowing investment advisers and regulated funds to hold digital assets, the ninth US agency crypto action since Aug. 18, even as Congress leaves the SEC-CFTC jurisdictional boundary unresolved.

timeline.text_zh: 新报道补充了 SEC 10月1日提案的具体内容：为注册投资顾问和受监管基金设立加密资产托管框架，允许在特定条件下自托管，并承认州信托公司可作为托管人；评论期60天，条款须待最终规则生效。
timeline.text_en: New report details the SEC's Oct. 1 proposal: creates a crypto custody framework for registered investment advisers and regulated funds, allows self-custody under certain conditions, recognizes state trust companies as custodians, and sets a 60-day comment period; provisions remain conditional until a final rule.

timeline.text_zh: SEC提出新规则，规范投资顾问必须如何托管加密资产，此举将为向客户提供数字资产敞口的公司正式确立合规义务。
timeline.text_en: The SEC proposed new rules governing how investment advisers must custody crypto assets, a step that would formalize compliance obligations for firms offering digital-asset exposure to clients.

threads.title_zh: 韩国目标 2027 年 2 月推出完整代币化证券市场
threads.title_en: South Korea targets February 2027 rollout for full tokenized securities market
threads.summary_zh: 韩国已从宣布2027年2月推出代币化证券市场的计划，推进到由金融服务委员会提出具体监管规则并进入公众咨询阶段，规则拟于2027年2月4日生效。
threads.summary_en: South Korea has moved from announcing a plan for a full tokenized securities market by February 2027 to the Financial Services Commission proposing detailed rules, now in public consultation, with the framework scheduled to take effect on Feb. 4, 2027.
threads.latest_update_zh: 韩国金融服务委员会提出了代币化证券发行与交易的具体规则，包括发行方最低资本要求、场外交易牌照和零售投资限额，并计划于11月11日前完成公众咨询，规则拟于2027年2月4日生效。
threads.latest_update_en: South Korea's Financial Services Commission proposed detailed rules for issuing and trading tokenized securities, including minimum capital requirements for issuers, OTC trading licenses and retail investment limits, with public consultation through Nov. 11 and planned effect on Feb. 4, 2027.
threads.background_zh: South Korea has announced a plan to launch a full tokenized securities market by February 2027, signaling a major regulatory step toward integrating digital assets into traditional finance.
threads.background_en: South Korea has announced a plan to launch a full tokenized securities market by February 2027, signaling a major regulatory step toward integrating digital assets into traditional finance.
threads.latest_summary_zh: South Korea's Financial Services Commission proposed detailed rules for issuing and trading tokenized securities — covering capital requirements, OTC trading licenses and retail investment limits — ahead of the framework taking effect in February 2027.
threads.latest_summary_en: South Korea's Financial Services Commission proposed detailed rules for issuing and trading tokenized securities — covering capital requirements, OTC trading licenses and retail investment limits — ahead of the framework taking effect in February 2027.

timeline.text_zh: 韩国金融服务委员会提出了代币化证券发行与交易的具体规则，包括发行方最低资本要求、场外交易牌照和零售投资限额，并计划于11月11日前完成公众咨询，规则拟于2027年2月4日生效。
timeline.text_en: South Korea's Financial Services Commission proposed detailed rules for issuing and trading tokenized securities, including minimum capital requirements for issuers, OTC trading licenses and retail investment limits, with public consultation through Nov. 11 and planned effect on Feb. 4, 2027.

timeline.text_zh: 韩国宣布计划在 2027 年 2 月前推出完整的代币化证券市场，标志着将数字资产纳入传统金融的重大监管举措。
timeline.text_en: South Korea has announced a plan to launch a full tokenized securities market by February 2027, signaling a major regulatory step toward integrating digital assets into traditional finance.

threads.title_zh: Tether的USDT本月“回家”重返比特币，距其首次在该网络亮相已过去十多年
threads.title_en: Tether's USDT is 'coming home' to Bitcoin this month over a decade after debut there
threads.summary_zh: Tether 支持的 Utexo 已获得在比特币网络发行 USDT 的商业许可，计划本月基于 RGB 协议和比特币 UTXO 模型发行原生 USDT，支持隐私转账、原生 BTC-USDT 兑换和 BTC 抵押借贷，之后扩展至 Lightning Network。
threads.summary_en: Tether-backed Utexo has obtained a commercial license to issue USDT on Bitcoin and plans to launch native USDT this month using the RGB protocol and Bitcoin's UTXO model, supporting private transfers, native BTC-USDT swaps and BTC-collateralized lending, with Lightning Network expansion to follow.
threads.latest_update_zh: Utexo 联合创始人 Viktor Ihnatiuk 表示公司已获得在比特币上发行 USDT 的商业许可，并披露将基于 RGB 协议与比特币 UTXO 模型实现，大部分交易数据保留在链下，并为交易所、钱包及支付服务商提供 API、SDK 和云端基础设施。
threads.latest_update_en: Utexo co-founder Viktor Ihnatiuk said the company has obtained a commercial license to issue USDT on Bitcoin, and disclosed it will use the RGB protocol and Bitcoin's UTXO model with most transaction data kept off-chain, offering APIs, SDKs and cloud infrastructure to exchanges, wallets and payment providers.
threads.background_zh: Tether-backed project Utexo plans to bring native USDT to Bitcoin this month, enabling private transfers, direct BTC-to-USDT swaps and bitcoin-backed loans with data kept off the public ledger, followed by Lightning Network support.
threads.background_en: Tether-backed project Utexo plans to bring native USDT to Bitcoin this month, enabling private transfers, direct BTC-to-USDT swaps and bitcoin-backed loans with data kept off the public ledger, followed by Lightning Network support.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Tether-backed Utexo says it has obtained a commercial license and plans to issue USDT on the Bitcoin network this month using the RGB protocol and Bitcoin's UTXO model, enabling private USDT transfers, native BTC-USDT swaps and BTC-collateralized lending before expanding to Lightning.
threads.latest_summary_en: Tether-backed Utexo says it has obtained a commercial license and plans to issue USDT on the Bitcoin network this month using the RGB protocol and Bitcoin's UTXO model, enabling private USDT transfers, native BTC-USDT swaps and BTC-collateralized lending before expanding to Lightning.

timeline.text_zh: Utexo 联合创始人 Viktor Ihnatiuk 表示公司已获得在比特币上发行 USDT 的商业许可，并披露将基于 RGB 协议与比特币 UTXO 模型实现，大部分交易数据保留在链下，并为交易所、钱包及支付服务商提供 API、SDK 和云端基础设施。
timeline.text_en: Utexo co-founder Viktor Ihnatiuk said the company has obtained a commercial license to issue USDT on Bitcoin, and disclosed it will use the RGB protocol and Bitcoin's UTXO model with most transaction data kept off-chain, offering APIs, SDKs and cloud infrastructure to exchanges, wallets and payment providers.

timeline.text_zh: Tether支持的项目Utexo计划本月将原生USDT引入比特币，支持隐私转账、BTC与USDT直接兑换以及比特币抵押贷款，且数据不保留在公共账本上，随后还将支持闪电网络。
timeline.text_en: Tether-backed project Utexo plans to bring native USDT to Bitcoin this month, enabling private transfers, direct BTC-to-USDT swaps and bitcoin-backed loans with data kept off the public ledger, followed by Lightning Network support.

threads.title_zh: 谷歌发布 Gemini 4 Argon 模型
threads.title_en: Google releases Gemini 4 Argon model
threads.summary_zh: 谷歌意外发布 Gemini 4，这是一款经过“RSI”增强的前沿模型，定位为性能超越 GPT 和 Opus，价格约为 Astra 的一半。
threads.summary_en: Google unexpectedly released Gemini 4, an 'RSI'-enhanced frontier model positioned as outperforming GPT and Opus and priced at roughly half the cost of Astra.
threads.latest_update_zh: Artificial Analysis 的独立评估发现，谷歌的 Gemini 4 Argon 在智能指数上以 53 分与 GPT-6 Astra 持平，其幻觉率远低（15%），API 入门价格也更便宜，但全价成本和答案准确性落后于 Astra。
threads.latest_update_en: Artificial Analysis' independent evaluation finds Google's Gemini 4 Argon ties GPT-6 Astra on the Intelligence Index at 53 points with a far lower hallucination rate (15%) and cheaper introductory API costs, though full-price costs and answer accuracy lag Astra.
threads.background_zh: 据 9to5Google 报道，Gemini 4 Argon 采用了新的命名体系，此前谷歌取消了 Gemini 3.5 Pro，并将重心放在 Gemini 3.8 Flash 上。前沿模型通常基于海量数据训练，成本极高，涵盖数据获取与处理以及算力开支。第三方对比报道将 Gemini 4 Argon 与 OpenAI 的 GPT-6 Astra 视为同代竞争对手。
threads.background_en: Gemini 4 Argon uses a new naming scheme and follows the cancellation of Gemini 3.5 Pro, with Google having focused on Gemini 3.8 Flash, according to 9to5Google. Frontier models are typically trained on vast datasets at very high cost, covering data acquisition and processing plus compute. Third-party comparison coverage places Gemini 4 Argon alongside OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra as a same-generation rival.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Artificial Analysis' independent evaluation finds Google's Gemini 4 Argon ties GPT-6 Astra on the Intelligence Index at 53 points with a far lower hallucination rate (15%) and cheaper introductory API costs, though full-price costs and answer accuracy lag Astra.
threads.latest_summary_en: Artificial Analysis' independent evaluation finds Google's Gemini 4 Argon ties GPT-6 Astra on the Intelligence Index at 53 points with a far lower hallucination rate (15%) and cheaper introductory API costs, though full-price costs and answer accuracy lag Astra.
threads.discussion_zh: 该发布与链上资产、托管或代币供给没有直接关联；对加密市场的可能传导渠道是情绪面，即去中心化算力、AI 代理等 AI 叙事类资产历来会对头部实验室的前沿模型发布作出反应。由于模型初期仅面向选定合作伙伴开放，目前尚不能确立开发者需求层面的即时变化。
threads.discussion_en: The release has no direct on-chain, custody or token-supply linkage; any crypto read-through runs through sentiment in AI-narrative assets such as decentralized-compute and AI-agent tokens, which have historically reacted to frontier-model announcements from major labs. Because availability is initially gated to select partners, no immediate developer-demand shift is established.
threads.market_impact_zh: 该发布与链上资产、托管或代币供给没有直接关联；对加密市场的可能传导渠道是情绪面，即去中心化算力、AI 代理等 AI 叙事类资产历来会对头部实验室的前沿模型发布作出反应。由于模型初期仅面向选定合作伙伴开放，目前尚不能确立开发者需求层面的即时变化。
threads.market_impact_en: The release has no direct on-chain, custody or token-supply linkage; any crypto read-through runs through sentiment in AI-narrative assets such as decentralized-compute and AI-agent tokens, which have historically reacted to frontier-model announcements from major labs. Because availability is initially gated to select partners, no immediate developer-demand shift is established.

timeline.text_zh: Artificial Analysis 的独立评估发现，谷歌的 Gemini 4 Argon 在智能指数上以 53 分与 GPT-6 Astra 持平，其幻觉率远低（15%），API 入门价格也更便宜，但全价成本和答案准确性落后于 Astra。
timeline.text_en: Artificial Analysis' independent evaluation finds Google's Gemini 4 Argon ties GPT-6 Astra on the Intelligence Index at 53 points with a far lower hallucination rate (15%) and cheaper introductory API costs, though full-price costs and answer accuracy lag Astra.

timeline.text_zh:
谷歌于 2026 年 9 月 30 日（周三）发布 Gemini 4 Argon，将其宣传为迄今最强大的模型，并定位为面向编程与网络安全工作的主力模型。据 CNBC 报道，该模型首先面向选定的网络安全合作伙伴推出，而非全面开放。

这是谷歌在前沿模型竞争中的最新一次发布；据 CNBC 报道，其初始投放仅面向选定的网络安全合作伙伴，而非所有开发者。谷歌将其定位为开发者、专业人士与企业解决难题的伙伴。

谷歌博客称，Gemini 4 Argon 在编程、知识工作、网络安全防御和创意写作方面具备“前沿级能力”。第三方评测机构 Artificial Analysis 将“Gemini 4 Argon (High)”列为智能水平领先的模型之一，并称其相对同类模型定价合理。
timeline.text_en: Google released Gemini 4 'Argon', which it markets as its most powerful model to date and pitches as a workhorse for coding and cybersecurity tasks.

threads.title_zh: Robinhood 在 HOOD Summit 发布加密永续合约、周末股票交易与 AI 交易智能体等新产品
threads.title_en: Robinhood将推出加密永续合约、美股周末交易及AI交易智能体
threads.summary_zh: Robinhood面向美国客户推出最高10倍杠杆的永续期货，将长期仅限于离岸场所的衍生品产品扩展至美国散户交易者。
threads.summary_en: Robinhood is launching perpetual futures with up to 10x leverage for US clients, extending a derivatives product long restricted to offshore venues to American retail traders.
threads.latest_update_zh: Robinhood已向其美国用户群推出10倍杠杆加密交易，将杠杆衍生品渠道扩展至主流散户客户。
threads.latest_update_en: Robinhood has rolled out 10x leveraged crypto trading to its US user base, extending leveraged derivatives access to mainstream retail customers.
threads.background_zh: 永续合约是没有到期日的加密衍生品，通常通过定期资金费率与现货价格锚定。另类交易系统（ATS）是美国非交易所类的交易场所，负责撮合买卖双方，Bruce ATS 即属于此类平台。Robinhood 一直在通过 Robinhood Derivatives 以及收购加密交易所 Bitstamp 来扩展其加密与衍生品业务。
threads.background_en: Perpetual futures are crypto derivatives without an expiration date, typically anchored to spot prices through periodic funding payments. Alternative trading systems (ATS) are non-exchange US trading venues that match buyers and sellers; Bruce ATS is such a venue. Robinhood has been expanding its crypto and derivatives footprint through Robinhood Derivatives and its acquisition of crypto exchange Bitstamp.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Robinhood has rolled out 10x leveraged crypto trading to its US user base, extending leveraged derivatives access to mainstream retail customers.
threads.latest_summary_en: Robinhood has rolled out 10x leveraged crypto trading to its US user base, extending leveraged derivatives access to mainstream retail customers.
threads.discussion_zh: 该计划为美国散户进入杠杆加密衍生品提供了新渠道，执行环节经由 Robinhood Derivatives 和 Bitstamp，可能影响 BTC 与 ETH 永续合约成交量与流动性相对离岸平台的分布；周末股票交易与延长的期权时段则把订单流引向 Bruce ATS 这一交易场所。AI 智能体功能会把模型驱动的订单流引入股票、期权和加密市场，但受其默认逐笔审批机制约束。
threads.discussion_en: The plan points to a new US retail channel into leveraged crypto derivatives, with execution routed through Robinhood Derivatives and Bitstamp, which could shift where BTC and ETH perpetual volume and liquidity sit relative to offshore venues; weekend equity and extended options hours route order flow through the Bruce ATS venue. The AI agent feature introduces model-driven order flow into stocks, options and crypto, subject to the stated per-trade approval default.
threads.market_impact_zh: 该计划为美国散户进入杠杆加密衍生品提供了新渠道，执行环节经由 Robinhood Derivatives 和 Bitstamp，可能影响 BTC 与 ETH 永续合约成交量与流动性相对离岸平台的分布；周末股票交易与延长的期权时段则把订单流引向 Bruce ATS 这一交易场所。AI 智能体功能会把模型驱动的订单流引入股票、期权和加密市场，但受其默认逐笔审批机制约束。
threads.market_impact_en: The plan points to a new US retail channel into leveraged crypto derivatives, with execution routed through Robinhood Derivatives and Bitstamp, which could shift where BTC and ETH perpetual volume and liquidity sit relative to offshore venues; weekend equity and extended options hours route order flow through the Bruce ATS venue. The AI agent feature introduces model-driven order flow into stocks, options and crypto, subject to the stated per-trade approval default.

timeline.text_zh: Robinhood已向其美国用户群推出10倍杠杆加密交易，将杠杆衍生品渠道扩展至主流散户客户。
timeline.text_en: Robinhood has rolled out 10x leveraged crypto trading to its US user base, extending leveraged derivatives access to mainstream retail customers.

timeline.text_zh:
Robinhood 周二在得克萨斯州休斯敦举行的 HOOD Summit 上公布一系列面向活跃交易者的新产品，包括可执行交易的 AI 智能体、最高提供 10 倍杠杆的加密永续合约，以及部分美国股票和 ETF 的周末交易。平台还将延长期权交易时间、增加日内保证金额度，并推出企业财报事件合约。

若这些产品按描述上线，将扩大美国散户对杠杆加密衍生品和智能体交易的可及范围，使 Robinhood 的业务从现有股票和现货加密进一步延伸。

加密永续合约将通过 Robinhood Derivatives 和 Bitstamp 向符合条件的美国用户提供，BTC 和 ETH 合约最高支持 10 倍杠杆，其他支持资产初期提供 3 倍杠杆。Robinhood Agents 允许用户在应用内选择 OpenAI 或 Anthropic 模型，并授权其访问独立交易账户；平台默认要求用户批准每笔交易，用户可选择关闭该限制，产品上线初期不支持保证金借贷。周末交易则将通过另类交易系统 Bruce ATS 提供，覆盖部分股票和 ETF。
timeline.text_en: Robinhood announced it will offer crypto perpetual futures with up to 10x leverage to eligible US users, weekend trading in select US stocks and ETFs, and AI trading agents powered by user-selected OpenAI or Anthropic models.

threads.summary_en: Armada Acquisition Corp. II shareholders approved the merger with Evernorth; the deal is expected to close on Oct. 7, 2026, with the combined company set to begin trading on Nasdaq under ticker XRPN the following day, subject to remaining closing conditions.
threads.latest_update_zh: Evernorth 预计合并将于 10 月 7 日完成，股票随后一天在纳斯达克以股票代码 XRPN 开始交易，交易预计筹集约 3 亿美元总现金收益。

threads.latest_summary_en: Evernorth shareholders approved its SPAC merger with Armada Acquisition Corp. II, setting up a Nasdaq debut under ticker XRPN with a 473 million XRP treasury valued at about $710 million.

timeline.text_en: Armada Acquisition Corp. II shareholders approved the merger with Evernorth, paving the way for the XRP treasury company holding roughly 473 million XRP to debut on Nasdaq.

threads.title_zh: Base 完成第三次主网升级 Cobalt
threads.title_en: Base Completes Third Mainnet Upgrade Cobalt
threads.summary_zh: Base 已完成第三次主网升级 Cobalt，该升级包含条件门控的 Validity Transactions、三项新的 B20 代币标准功能，以及针对 B20 的可选行政余额扣押规则（seizeWithMemo）。
threads.summary_en: Base completed its third mainnet upgrade, Cobalt, which includes condition-gated Validity Transactions, three new B20 token-standard features, and an opt-in administrative balance-seizure rule (seizeWithMemo) for B20 tokens.
threads.latest_update_zh: Cobalt 升级为 B20 代币引入可选的行政余额扣押规则（seizeWithMemo），要求发行方配置资格、SEIZE_ROLE 授权，并单独设置接收方策略，同时保留代币供应量，原有 burnBlocked 被弃用但仍可调用。
threads.latest_update_en: The Cobalt upgrade introduces an opt-in administrative balance-seizure rule (seizeWithMemo) for B20 tokens, requiring issuer eligibility configuration, SEIZE_ROLE authorization, and a separate recipient policy, while preserving token supply and keeping burnBlocked deprecated but callable.
threads.background_zh: Base completed its third mainnet upgrade, Cobalt, adding condition-gated Validity Transactions and three new B20 token-standard features, with a roadmap toward 200ms block times, native smart accounts, and gas sponsorship.
threads.background_en: Base completed its third mainnet upgrade, Cobalt, adding condition-gated Validity Transactions and three new B20 token-standard features, with a roadmap toward 200ms block times, native smart accounts, and gas sponsorship.

threads.title_zh: Gemini 4 Argon：我们通往前沿智能的下一个时代
threads.title_en: Gemini 4 Argon: our next era of frontier intelligence
threads.summary_zh: 谷歌发布了 Gemini 4 Argon，并将其作为新一代旗舰长程模型。单次输出上限从此前 64K tokens 提高到 100 万 tokens。模型暂不向普通用户开放，首批仅通过 Fairwind Program 提供给可信网络安全团队，后续再逐步开放给付费 API 客户和 Google AI Ultra 用户。API 定价初期为每百万输入 tokens 2 美元、输出 10 美元，之后翻倍至 4 美元和 20 美元。官方评测中，Argon 在 DeepSWE v1.1 得 77.9%，高于 GPT-6 Astra 和 Claude Opus 5.5，但在 FrontierSWE、Terminal-Bench 4.0 及部分科学任务上仍落后。谷歌重点强化了网络安全能力，可信防御团队版本甚至会取消部分网络安全限制；正式开放前，谷歌仍在测试滥用、提示词注入和 Agent 越界等风险。
threads.summary_en: Google released Gemini 4 Argon as its next flagship long-horizon model. Its single-pass output limit jumps from 64K tokens to 1 million tokens. The model is not yet open to ordinary users; initial access is only through the Fairwind Program to trusted cybersecurity teams, with later rollout to paid API customers and Google AI Ultra users. API pricing starts at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, later doubling to $4 and $20. In official evaluations, Argon scores 77.9% on DeepSWE v1.1, ahead of GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5, but still trails on FrontierSWE, Terminal-Bench 4.0 and some scientific tasks. Google emphasized cybersecurity capabilities, with trusted defender versions even removing some cyber restrictions; before formal opening, Google is still testing abuse, prompt injection and agent boundary risks.
threads.latest_update_zh: 新报道补充了 Gemini 4 Argon 的关键细节：单次输出上限从 64K tokens 提升至 100 万 tokens；首批仅通过 Fairwind Program 向可信网络安全团队开放，后续再逐步开放给付费 API 客户和 Google AI Ultra 用户；API 上线初期按每百万输入 tokens 2 美元、输出 10 美元收费，之后价格翻倍至 4 美元和 20 美元；在 DeepSWE v1.1 得 77.9%，领先 GPT-6 Astra 的 74.1% 和 Claude Opus 5.5 的 74.2%，但在 FrontierSWE、Terminal-Bench 4.0 和部分科学任务上仍落后；网络安全能力被重点强化，可信防御团队版本会取消部分网络安全限制，同时谷歌仍在测试滥用、提示词注入和 Agent 越界等风险。
threads.latest_update_en: The new report adds key details about Gemini 4 Argon: its single-pass output limit jumps from 64K tokens to 1 million tokens; initial access is only through the Fairwind Program to trusted cybersecurity teams, with later rollout to paid API customers and Google AI Ultra users; API pricing starts at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, later doubling to $4 and $20; it scores 77.9% on DeepSWE v1.1, ahead of GPT-6 Astra's 74.1% and Claude Opus 5.5's 74.2%, but still trails on FrontierSWE, Terminal-Bench 4.0 and some scientific tasks; cybersecurity capabilities are emphasized, with trusted defender versions removing some cyber restrictions, while Google continues testing abuse, prompt injection and agent boundary risks.
threads.background_zh: Argon 是谷歌 Gemini 旗舰系列的后续产品：Gemini 3 于 11 月发布，而 DeepMind 首席技术官 Koray Kavukcuoglu 担任新设立的谷歌首席 AI 架构师一职，职责是加快公司 AI 技术的产品化。“前沿模型”是产业与政策领域的术语，指处于当前通用人工智能能力最前沿或接近最前沿的模型，而非固定的技术类别。
threads.background_en: Argon arrives as the successor in Google's Gemini flagship line: Gemini 3 was released in November, and Koray Kavukcuoglu, DeepMind's chief technology officer, holds the newly created role of Google chief AI architect aimed at accelerating productization of the company's AI technology. "Frontier model" is an industry and policy term for a model at or near the current leading edge of general-purpose AI capability, rather than a fixed technical class.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Google DeepMind released Gemini 4 Argon, a flagship long-horizon model whose single-pass output limit jumps from 64K to 1 million tokens, initially offered only to trusted cybersecurity teams via the Fairwind Program before wider API and consumer rollout.
threads.latest_summary_en: Google DeepMind released Gemini 4 Argon, a flagship long-horizon model whose single-pass output limit jumps from 64K to 1 million tokens, initially offered only to trusted cybersecurity teams via the Fairwind Program before wider API and consumer rollout.
threads.discussion_zh: Hacker News 上的评论意见不一。一些人对受限的发布方式提出批评，指出非 Flash 模型再次对普通订阅用户无限期不可用，并质疑付费档位的价值；也有人认为各实验室之间的持续交替领先，削弱了“AI 是赢者通吃、先发优势永不丢失”这一与 Anthropic 的 Dario Amodei 相关的看法。另有用户描述了一次 Gemini 3.8 Flash 的使用经历：该模型将 GDB 附加到 GPU 驱动、逆向内核队列 ioctl 接口，并编写 LD_PRELOAD 垫片，使 ROCm 版 llama.cpp 在 Strix Halo 机器上运行起来。
threads.discussion_en: Commenters on Hacker News were divided. Several criticized the restricted rollout, noting that a non-Flash model is again unavailable to regular subscribers for an indefinite period and questioning the value of paid tiers, while one argued the steady leapfrogging between labs undercuts the idea — associated with Anthropic's Dario Amodei — that AI is a winner-takes-all field where an early lead is never ceded. Another user described a Gemini 3.8 Flash session in which the model attached GDB to a GPU driver, reverse-engineered a kernel queue ioctl interface and wrote an LD_PRELOAD shim to get ROCm llama.cpp working on a Strix Halo machine.
threads.market_impact_zh: 与加密市场相关的传导渠道主要是情绪面，而非公告披露的任何集成：大型实验室发布前沿模型往往会推动围绕 AI 相关代币和去中心化算力代币的叙事，尽管该公告本身并未披露与加密市场在托管、流动性、上币或监管方面的任何关联。任何影响都将通过交易者在这类 AI 主题板块上的仓位体现，而非通过目前仍受限的 Gemini 4 Argon 本身的可获得性。
threads.market_impact_en: The crypto-relevant transmission channel is sentiment rather than any disclosed integration: frontier-model releases from major labs tend to feed narratives around AI-adjacent and decentralized compute tokens, even though the announcement itself discloses no custody, liquidity, listing or regulatory linkage to crypto markets. Any effect would run through trader positioning on those AI-themed segments rather than through Gemini 4 Argon's own availability, which remains restricted.

timeline.text_en: The new report adds key details about Gemini 4 Argon: its single-pass output limit jumps from 64K tokens to 1 million tokens; initial access is only through the Fairwind Program to trusted cybersecurity teams, with later rollout to paid API customers and Google AI Ultra users; API pricing starts at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, later doubling to $4 and $20; it scores 77.9% on DeepSWE v1.1, ahead of GPT-6 Astra's 74.1% and Claude Opus 5.5's 74.2%, but still trails on FrontierSWE, Terminal-Bench 4.0 and some scientific tasks; cybersecurity capabilities are emphasized, with trusted defender versions removing some cyber restrictions, while Google continues testing abuse, prompt injection and agent boundary risks.

timeline.text_zh:
谷歌发布了其新一代前沿 AI 模型 Gemini 4 Argon。谷歌首席 AI 架构师、Google DeepMind 高级副总裁 Koray Kavukcuoglu 表示，该模型在“真实软件工程、法律与金融等企业知识工作，以及网络安全防御等复杂工作流中提供前沿性能”。谷歌目前限制该模型的访问权限，称将继续从早期测试者处收集反馈并迭代护栏机制，之后再向开发者、企业和消费者开放 Argon。

该发布使顶级实验室之间的竞争再添一款旗舰模型，但访问权限仍受限——开发者、企业和消费者目前尚不能普遍使用，谷歌给出的理由是仍在完善护栏机制并收集早期测试者反馈。

谷歌称 Argon 在编程、推理和多模态方面具备能力，并能在企业工作流中持续完成长链条、多步骤任务。Hacker News 评论者引用公告称，Argon 智能体正在谷歌内部将 C/C++ 代码库迁移至 Rust；独立评测机构 Artificial Analysis 将 Gemini 4 Argon（High）列为智能水平领先的模型之一，且相对于同等价位的模型定价合理。
timeline.text_en:
Google unveiled Gemini 4 Argon, its next frontier AI model, which the company says delivers "frontier performance in complex workflows across real-world software engineering, enterprise knowledge work like legal and finance, and cybersecurity defense," according to chief AI architect and Google DeepMind SVP Koray Kavukcuoglu. Google is limiting access to the model for now, saying it will keep gathering feedback from early testers as it iterates on guardrails before making Argon available to developers, enterprises and consumers.

The announcement puts a new flagship model into the top-lab competition, but access remains restricted — developers, enterprises and consumers cannot yet use it generally, with Google citing continued work on guardrails and feedback from early testers as the reason.

Google describes Argon's capabilities across coding, reasoning and multimodality, and its ability to sustain long, multi-step tasks in enterprise workflows. Hacker News commenters quoted the announcement as saying Argon agents are working on migrating C/C++ codebases to Rust across Google; independent evaluator Artificial Analysis rates Gemini 4 Argon (High) as among the leading models in intelligence and reasonably priced relative to models at a similar price point.

ranking.title_zh: Coinbase 完成 Deribit 整合并获 CFTC 批准设立清算所
ranking.title_en: Coinbase Completes Deribit Integration and Plans Year-End Pro Service Relaunch
ranking.summary_zh: Coinbase 已完成 Deribit 整合，成立统一的 Coinbase Global Exchange，并使符合条件的美国客户能够通过受 CFTC 监管的 Coinbase Financial Markets 接入全球加密期权和永续合约流动性；美国机构客户可通过 Coinbase Prime 和 Coinbase Financial Markets 接入，美国零售期权预计今年晚些时候推出。公司还计划年底前重新推出 Coinbase Pro。
ranking.summary_en: Coinbase has completed its Deribit integration to form the unified Coinbase Global Exchange and now enables eligible US customers to access global crypto options and perpetual futures liquidity through CFTC-regulated Coinbase Financial Markets; US institutional clients can access via Coinbase Prime and Coinbase Financial Markets, with US retail options expected later this year. It also plans to relaunch Coinbase Pro by year-end.
ranking.latest_update_zh: Coinbase 的 Deribit 整合现已为符合条件的美国客户提供通过受 CFTC 监管的 Coinbase Financial Markets 接入全球加密期权和永续合约流动性的途径；美国机构客户可通过 Coinbase Prime 和 Coinbase Financial Markets 接入，美国零售期权预计今年晚些时候推出。
ranking.latest_update_en: Coinbase's Deribit integration now gives eligible US customers access to global crypto options and perpetual futures liquidity through CFTC-regulated Coinbase Financial Markets; US institutional clients can access via Coinbase Prime and Coinbase Financial Markets, with US retail options expected later this year.
ranking.background_zh: DCO牌照允许机构作为衍生品交易的中央对手方，通过清算与结算交易来降低对手方风险，该牌照由美国CFTC颁发。加密交易所一直在争取此类牌照以将业务从现货拓展至衍生品领域——Gemini旗下的Olympus部门近期也获得了CFTC颁发的DCO牌照。
ranking.background_en: A DCO license allows an entity to act as a central counterparty for derivative trades, clearing and settling transactions to reduce counterparty risk, and is issued by the CFTC in the United States. Crypto exchanges have been seeking these licenses to expand beyond spot trading — Gemini's Olympus division recently obtained a DCO license from the CFTC.
ranking.latest_summary_zh: Coinbase has completed its Deribit integration, letting eligible US customers access global crypto options and perpetual futures liquidity through its CFTC-regulated Coinbase Financial Markets unit, with US retail options expected later this year.
ranking.latest_summary_en: Coinbase has completed its Deribit integration, letting eligible US customers access global crypto options and perpetual futures liquidity through its CFTC-regulated Coinbase Financial Markets unit, with US retail options expected later this year.
ranking.discussion_zh: 将期权与永续合约流动性集中于单一平台，会使衍生品订单流、资金费与结算活动进一步集中，并改变通过 Coinbase Bermuda Limited 接入的非美国机构账户的执行与对手方安排。同一平台同时提供股票与 IPO 前市场，也使这些账户可交易的产品与抵押品种类超出加密衍生品范围。
ranking.discussion_en: Concentrating options and perpetuals liquidity on a single venue concentrates derivatives order flow, funding and settlement activity, and changes execution and counterparty arrangements for the non-US institutional accounts that trade there through Coinbase Bermuda Limited. Adding equities and pre-IPO markets to the same platform also broadens the product and collateral mix available to those accounts beyond crypto derivatives.

ranking.title_zh: ICE与OKX合资公司OKXICE向SEC申请推出24/7代币化美股交易场所
ranking.title_en: OKX-ICE Joint Venture Files with SEC for Tokenized Stock Trading
ranking.summary_zh:
据报道，纽约证券交易所母公司ICE与加密交易所OKX正筹划提供7×24小时的代币化股票交易，将传统交易所基础设施与加密原生连续交易市场结合。该合作被描述为仍处于早期阶段，尚未得到证实。

若该报道属实，这将把纽约证券交易所的运营方与加密原生交易平台连接起来，是传统交易所基础设施与数字资产市场的一次显著融合。其实际影响取决于相关计划能否走出目前报道中的早期阶段。

相关报道尚未得到ICE或OKX证实，也未披露上线时间、产品结构或监管批准等细节。ICE运营13家受监管交易所和6家清算所，并拥有数字资产托管业务ICE Digital Trust；OKX的前身是2013年成立的同名交易所Okcoin。
ranking.summary_en:
ICE, the parent company of the New York Stock Exchange, and crypto exchange OKX are reportedly planning to offer 24/7 tokenized stock trading, combining traditional exchange infrastructure with crypto-native continuous markets. The reported collaboration is described as early-stage and has not been confirmed.

The reported tie-up would connect the operator of the NYSE with a crypto-native trading venue, a notable convergence of traditional exchange infrastructure and digital-asset markets. Any concrete effect depends on whether the plans advance beyond the reported early stage.

The reports remain unconfirmed by ICE or OKX, and no launch date, product structure or regulatory approvals were detailed. ICE operates 13 regulated exchanges and six clearing houses and owns ICE Digital Trust, a digital asset custody business; OKX began in 2013 as the exchange Okcoin.

若该报道属实，这将把纽约证券交易所的运营方与加密原生交易平台连接起来，是传统交易所基础设施与数字资产市场的一次显著融合。其实际影响取决于相关计划能否走出目前报道中的早期阶段。

相关报道尚未得到ICE或OKX证实，也未披露上线时间、产品结构或监管批准等细节。ICE运营13家受监管交易所和6家清算所，并拥有数字资产托管业务ICE Digital Trust；OKX的前身是2013年成立的同名交易所Okcoin。
ranking.latest_update_en:
ICE, the parent company of the New York Stock Exchange, and crypto exchange OKX are reportedly planning to offer 24/7 tokenized stock trading, combining traditional exchange infrastructure with crypto-native continuous markets. The reported collaboration is described as early-stage and has not been confirmed.

The reported tie-up would connect the operator of the NYSE with a crypto-native trading venue, a notable convergence of traditional exchange infrastructure and digital-asset markets. Any concrete effect depends on whether the plans advance beyond the reported early stage.

The reports remain unconfirmed by ICE or OKX, and no launch date, product structure or regulatory approvals were detailed. ICE operates 13 regulated exchanges and six clearing houses and owns ICE Digital Trust, a digital asset custody business; OKX began in 2013 as the exchange Okcoin.
ranking.background_zh: 此次申报之前，SEC 已发布命令，授予临时、有条件的豁免救济——即“创新豁免”——以推动部分代币化股票的链上交易，相关数字资产必须附带完整股东权益，包括分红权和投票权。在授予豁免时，SEC 就隔夜代币化股票交易可能如何影响流动性、定价以及传统市场的开盘、重开和收盘流程征求了公众意见。ICE 与 OKX 此前已组建合资公司 OKXICE，用于搭建连接传统金融与 7×24 小时数字资产市场的基础设施，安德鲁·库莫担任联席主席。
ranking.background_en: The filing follows the SEC's order granting temporary, conditional exemptive relief — the "Innovation Exemption" — to facilitate onchain trading of certain tokenized stocks, under which digital assets must carry full shareholder benefits such as dividends and voting rights. In granting the exemption, the SEC sought public comment on how overnight tokenized-stock trading could affect liquidity, pricing and the opening, reopening and closing processes of conventional markets. ICE and OKX previously formed OKXICE as a joint venture to build infrastructure bridging traditional and 24/7 digital asset markets, with Andrew Cuomo as co-chair.

ranking.title_zh: CFTC提出CTX与CAM规则，建立联邦加密交易所监管框架
ranking.title_en: CFTC Proposes CTX and CAM Rules to Establish Federal Crypto Exchange Framework
ranking.summary_zh: CFTC拟议规则建立联邦加密交易框架，其中杠杆交易仅限联邦监管平台，100倍杠杆被明确禁止。
ranking.summary_en: The CFTC's proposed rules establish a federal crypto trading framework in which leveraged trading is limited to federally regulated platforms and 100x leverage is explicitly prohibited.
ranking.latest_update_zh:
CFTC 公布了一份初步提案，拟通过两项新规——Regulation CTX 与 Regulation CAM——建立加密交易所的联邦许可框架，文件在《联邦公报》刊登后将开启为期 60 天的公众意见征询期。此时距《Clarity 法案》在参议院夭折已有三周，同日 SEC 还批准了 3 倍杠杆的 BTC 和 ETH 基金上市交易。

该计划提出了单一的联邦许可选择，并以是否涉及杠杆来决定谁需要持牌，这是国会未能通过的框架，将允许美国交易平台提供目前无法提供的保证金类产品。不过这是一份征求意见的初步概念文件，并非具有约束力的规则文本。

牌照将覆盖撮合买卖双方、托管客户资金与加密资产、结算交易以及借贷，每项业务需分别获批；交易将通过已受反洗钱规则约束的经纪商进行，且只有这些经纪商或其保荐银行可以提供杠杆。该机构还在考虑储备金证明要求，以及针对易被操纵代币的上市标准；CFTC 主席 Mike Selig 表示，这些规则的目的是防止类似 FTX 的欺诈，而非事后追诉。
ranking.latest_update_en: The CFTC published a preliminary plan to federally license and regulate crypto exchanges via proposed Regulations CTX and CAM and opened a 60-day public comment period, while the SEC cleared 3x levered Bitcoin and Ether funds for trading.
ranking.background_zh: 参议院未能达到推进《CLARITY 法案》所需的 60 票门槛，该法案本将为数字资产建立法定框架。美国加密交易目前要么适用为其他市场制定的规则，要么适用各州不一的地方牌照。CFTC 的这份通知还否定了该机构在拜登时期对 Kraken、Ooki DAO 和 Uniswap 的执法案件，称其为“以执法代替监管”。
ranking.background_en: The Senate failed to reach the 60 votes needed to advance the CLARITY Act, which would have created a statutory framework for digital assets. Crypto trading in the US currently runs under rules built for other markets or under state licenses that vary by state. The CFTC notice also disowns the agency's Biden-era cases against Kraken, Ooki DAO and Uniswap as regulation by enforcement.
ranking.latest_summary_zh: The CFTC published a preliminary plan to federally license and regulate crypto exchanges via proposed Regulations CTX and CAM and opened a 60-day public comment period, while the SEC cleared 3x levered Bitcoin and Ether funds for trading.
ranking.latest_summary_en: The CFTC published a preliminary plan to federally license and regulate crypto exchanges via proposed Regulations CTX and CAM and opened a 60-day public comment period, while the SEC cleared 3x levered Bitcoin and Ether funds for trading.
ranking.discussion_zh: 传导路径在于美国市场准入：联邦牌照将使本土交易所能够上线目前主要在离岸提供的杠杆及永续类产品，涉及交易所股票、在岸永续合约场所及为其撮合交易的经纪商，而更清晰的规则也会降低银行和券商涉足加密业务的门槛。由于该文件只是开启意见征询期，近期影响限于围绕美国受监管场所的情绪与仓位，而非已生效的规则。
ranking.discussion_en: The transmission path runs through US market access: a federal license would let domestic exchanges list leveraged and perpetual-style products now largely offered offshore, putting exchange equities, listed perp venues and the brokers routing those trades in scope, with clear rules also lowering the barrier for banks and brokers to touch crypto. Because the document only opens a comment period, near-term effects are confined to sentiment and positioning around US-regulated venues rather than to rules in force.

timeline.text_en: The CFTC proposed its first formal crypto market rules through new CTX and CAM regulations, abandoning an enforcement-only approach to regulating digital asset markets.

timeline.text_en: The CFTC has issued further guidance affirming that U.S. commodities and derivatives firms can invest in tokenized assets and use blockchain records for compliance, signaling continued regulatory openness to tokenization.

timeline.text_zh: CFTC主席Mike Selig在CNBC表示现在是制定加密市场结构规则的“时候”，将聚焦永续合约并动用现有法定权力；此前参议院否决了Clarity Act。同时SEC批准五年创新豁免、CFTC发布不行动函并提交两项预规则。
timeline.text_en: CFTC Chair Mike Selig said on CNBC it is 'go time' for the agency to write crypto market-structure rules, focused on perpetuals, using existing statutory authority after the Senate blocked the Clarity Act; SEC also approved a five-year Innovation Exemption and CFTC issued a no-action letter and filed two prerules.

ranking.title_zh: Igloo旗下Abstract L2宣布将于12月15日关停并转向胖企鹅
ranking.title_en: Igloo's Abstract L2 to shut down on Dec. 15 and pivot to Pudgy Penguins
ranking.summary_zh: Igloo Inc. 正逐步关停 Abstract 链并转向 Pudgy Penguins/PENGU；Abstract L2 已确定 12月15日关停，用户须在该期限前桥出资产，否则资金将无法访问；公司放弃通过代币发行救助该链。
ranking.summary_en: Igloo Inc. is winding down the Abstract chain and pivoting to Pudgy Penguins/PENGU; Abstract’s Ethereum L2 is now set to shut down on Dec. 15, users must bridge assets off before the deadline or funds become inaccessible, and the company has forgone a token launch to save the chain.
ranking.latest_update_zh: Abstract 已确定将于 12月15日关停其以太坊 L2，并要求用户在截止前跨链转出资产；Igloo CEO 称已损失数千万美元，并放弃通过发行代币来救助该链。
ranking.latest_update_en: Abstract has set Dec. 15 as the shutdown date for its Ethereum L2, warned users to bridge assets off the chain before then, and Igloo’s CEO said the company lost tens of millions of dollars while forgoing a token launch as a lifeline.
ranking.background_zh: Abstract 是一条 ZK-rollup，即通过零知识证明把交易打包并在以太坊上验证的 Layer 2 网络，Igloo 将其定位为面向普通用户的“消费者加密”应用之家。2024 年 7 月，Igloo 在 Founders Fund 领投的一轮融资中筹集了超过 1100 万美元，用于成立 Cube Labs 并支持 Abstract 的开发。团队将关停归因于 DeFi 生态有限、链上流动性稀薄、与机构交集较少以及预算少于竞争对手，并写道“专注于消费者加密的链作为独立模式最终被证明是不可持续的”。
ranking.background_en: Abstract is a ZK-rollup, a layer-2 network that bundles transactions and verifies them on Ethereum using zero-knowledge proofs, and Igloo pitched it as a home for "consumer crypto" apps aimed at everyday users. In July 2024, Igloo raised over $11 million in a Founders Fund-led round to establish Cube Labs and support Abstract's development. The team attributed the shutdown to a limited DeFi ecosystem, thin on-chain liquidity, little crossover with institutions and a smaller budget than rivals, writing that "operating a chain focused exclusively on consumer crypto has ultimately proven to be unsustainable as a standalone model."
ranking.latest_summary_zh: Abstract will shut down its Ethereum L2 on Dec. 15 after losing tens of millions of dollars, citing stagnant growth and thin liquidity, and warns users to bridge assets off the chain before funds become inaccessible.
ranking.latest_summary_en: Abstract will shut down its Ethereum L2 on Dec. 15 after losing tens of millions of dollars, citing stagnant growth and thin liquidity, and warns users to bridge assets off the chain before funds become inaccessible.
ranking.discussion_zh: Abstract 的关停会通过 Migration Hub 和原生跨链桥把用户资金与应用流动性导向其他链，而 Igloo 明确表示将重新聚焦 Pudgy Penguins 与 PENGU，使该事件直接关联到该代币及相关 NFT 系列的持有者。与 Blast 的关停一起，这也延续了近期以太坊 Layer 2 收缩的趋势。
ranking.discussion_en: Abstract's shutdown directs user funds and app liquidity toward other chains through its Migration Hub and native bridge, while Igloo's stated refocus on Pudgy Penguins and PENGU links the event directly to holders of that token and the related NFT collections. It also adds to the recent pattern of Ethereum layer-2 consolidation, alongside Blast's wind-down.

timeline.text_zh: Igloo Inc. 正在逐步关闭其 Abstract 链，全面转向 Pudgy Penguins、Pudgy NFT 和 PENGU。公告发布后不久，一个新地址从 Kraken 转出 100 万美元，抢购了 25 个 Pudgy Penguin NFT。
timeline.text_en: Igloo Inc. is winding down its Abstract chain and pivoting entirely to Pudgy Penguins, Pudgy NFTs and PENGU, with a new address moving $1M off Kraken to snap up 25 Pudgy Penguin NFTs shortly after the announcement.

timeline.text_zh: 新报道补充了关键量化事实：截至周三，Abstract 网络上仍有约 7600 万美元用户资产需要在关停前转移，否则将无法取回；同时披露链上费用约 3,900 美元/24 小时，而生态应用收入约 39,000 美元，并指出 Abstract 于 2025 年 1 月上线、Igloo 已资助约 18 个月，团队明确拒绝发币或 ICO 融资。
timeline.text_en: The report adds key quantified facts: about $76 million in user assets remained on Abstract as of Wednesday and must be moved before the Dec. 15 shutdown or become inaccessible; it also reports roughly $3,900 in 24-hour chain fees versus about $39,000 in application revenue, notes Abstract launched in January 2025 and was funded by Igloo for about 18 months, and says the team explicitly rejected launching a token or ICO.

timeline.text_zh: Pudgy Penguins 创始人 Luca Netz 确认 Abstract 正在逐步关闭，累计亏损达数千万美元，母公司 Igloo Inc 将全部精力转向 Pudgy Penguins、Pudgy NFTs 及 PENGU。
timeline.text_en: Pudgy Penguins founder Luca Netz confirmed Abstract is being wound down after cumulative losses in the tens of millions of dollars, with parent Igloo Inc refocusing entirely on Pudgy Penguins, Pudgy NFTs and PENGU.

timeline.text_zh: 与 Pudgy Penguins 相关的面向消费者的 Layer 2 项目 Abstract 宣布将于 12 月 15 日停止运营，此前已运行约两年，据称其链上日收入仅为 2,646 美元。
timeline.text_en: Abstract, the consumer-focused Layer 2 associated with Pudgy Penguins, announced it will shut down on December 15 after roughly two years of operation, with on-chain daily revenue reportedly just $2,646.

ranking.title_zh: MetaMask基础设施安全事件：主动退出受影响验证者
ranking.title_en: MetaMask Infrastructure Security Incident: Proactive Exit of Affected Validators
ranking.summary_zh: MetaMask 基础设施安全事件引发的预防性验证者退出已把以太坊退出队列推高至 2026 年峰值约 851,000 ETH（10 月 2 日），10 月 5 日仍有约 786,000 ETH 排队，等待接近 14 天；Lido 预计相关 ETH 将逐步重新质押，过程可能长达约 45 天，最后一批受影响 MetaMask 验证者预计 10 月 7 日前退出质押。MetaMask 表示未发现钱包或客户资金受影响，客户提款密钥不受其控制。
ranking.summary_en: The precautionary validator exits tied to MetaMask’s infrastructure security incident pushed Ethereum’s exit queue to a 2026 peak of about 851,000 ETH on Oct. 2; about 786,000 ETH remained queued on Oct. 5 with an estimated wait of nearly 14 days. Lido expects the affected ETH to be gradually restaked over a process that could take up to about 45 days, with the last affected MetaMask validators expected to stop staking by Oct. 7. MetaMask said it found no indication wallets or customer funds were affected, and client withdrawal keys remain outside its control.
ranking.latest_update_zh: 以太坊验证者退出队列在 MetaMask 预防性退出验证者后升至 2026 年最长：10 月 2 日约 851,000 ETH，10 月 5 日仍有约 786,000 ETH 排队，等待约 14 天；Lido 预计受影响 ETH 将逐步重新质押，整个过程可能长达约 45 天，最后一批受影响的 MetaMask 验证者预计在 10 月 7 日前停止质押。同时进入质押队列降至约 150 万 ETH、等待约 25 天，较 9 月初约 200 万 ETH/35 天降温。
ranking.latest_update_en: Ethereum’s validator exit queue became the longest of 2026 after MetaMask’s precautionary validator exits: about 851,000 ETH on Oct. 2, with about 786,000 ETH still queued on Oct. 5 and an estimated nearly 14-day wait; Lido expects the affected ETH to be gradually restaked over a process that could take up to about 45 days, with the last affected MetaMask validators expected to stop staking by Oct. 7. The entry queue separately fell to about 1.5 million ETH/25 days, down from about 2 million ETH/35 days in early September.
ranking.background_zh: Tornado Cash 是运行在以太坊上的开源、非托管隐私协议，通过混合交易来模糊资金的来源与去向，已被美国财政部制裁。此次事件与 Kiln 此前的案例相似：Kiln 在 SOL 质押业务中损失 4,100 万美元后，退出了全部活跃 ETH 验证者并轮换签名密钥，将相关操作视为"可能已被攻破"。今年 7 月，Drop Site News 报道称，MetaMask 的开发方 ConsenSys 曾误聘一名与朝鲜有关联的软件开发者担任约一个月的顾问，但该报道并未表示这一任职与受影响的质押业务有关。
ranking.background_en: Tornado Cash is an open-source, non-custodial privacy protocol on Ethereum that mixes transactions to obscure their origin and destination, and it has been sanctioned by the U.S. Treasury. The incident resembles a prior case in which Kiln suffered a $41 million loss in its SOL staking operations and responded by exiting all active ETH validators and rotating signing keys, treating related operations as potentially compromised. In July, Drop Site News reported that ConsenSys, MetaMask's developer, accidentally hired a software developer linked to North Korea as a consultant for about a month, though that report does not suggest the role was related to the affected staking operations.
ranking.latest_summary_zh: Ethereum's validator exit queue reached its longest of 2026 with about 786,000 ETH (~$2 billion) awaiting withdrawal and a nearly 14-day wait, after MetaMask began pulling validators as a precaution following a security incident, while entry queues fell over a quarter since early September.
ranking.latest_summary_en: Ethereum's validator exit queue reached its longest of 2026 with about 786,000 ETH (~$2 billion) awaiting withdrawal and a nearly 14-day wait, after MetaMask began pulling validators as a precaution following a security incident, while entry queues fell over a quarter since early September.
ranking.discussion_zh: 该事件局限于 Consensys 运营的质押基础设施，而非用户托管环节，因此对市场的直接传导渠道在于以太坊验证者运营：轮换密钥会使相关验证者经历退出与进入队列，可能影响队列等待时间与质押流向。钱包层面的影响主要限于自托管工具的市场情绪，因为 Lubin 表示用户密钥与资产未被涉及。
ranking.discussion_en: The incident is confined to Consensys-operated staking infrastructure rather than user custody, so the direct channel to markets runs through Ethereum validator operations: rotating keys sends affected validators through the exit and entry queues, which can shift queue waits and staking flows. Wallet-side exposure is limited to sentiment around self-custody tools, since Lubin said user keys and assets were not involved.

timeline.text_zh: 以太坊验证者退出队列在 MetaMask 预防性退出验证者后升至 2026 年最长：10 月 2 日约 851,000 ETH，10 月 5 日仍有约 786,000 ETH 排队，等待约 14 天；Lido 预计受影响 ETH 将逐步重新质押，整个过程可能长达约 45 天，最后一批受影响的 MetaMask 验证者预计在 10 月 7 日前停止质押。同时进入质押队列降至约 150 万 ETH、等待约 25 天，较 9 月初约 200 万 ETH/35 天降温。
timeline.text_en: Ethereum’s validator exit queue became the longest of 2026 after MetaMask’s precautionary validator exits: about 851,000 ETH on Oct. 2, with about 786,000 ETH still queued on Oct. 5 and an estimated nearly 14-day wait; Lido expects the affected ETH to be gradually restaked over a process that could take up to about 45 days, with the last affected MetaMask validators expected to stop staking by Oct. 7. The entry queue separately fell to about 1.5 million ETH/25 days, down from about 2 million ETH/35 days in early September.

timeline.text_zh: Consensys 创始人 Joseph Lubin 首次公开回应称，没有迹象显示 MetaMask 钱包或客户资金受到该基础设施安全事件影响；作为预防措施，团队与合作伙伴已轮换验证者密钥，并强调验证者密钥与提款密钥分离，团队不持有客户提款密钥，可防止未经授权的质押 ETH 转移。
timeline.text_en: Consensys founder Joseph Lubin publicly responded for the first time, saying there is no indication that MetaMask wallets or customer funds were affected by the infrastructure security incident; as a precaution, his team and partners rotated validator keys, and he emphasized that validator and withdrawal keys are separate and the team does not hold clients' withdrawal keys, preventing unauthorized transfers of staked ETH.

timeline.text_zh: 以太坊验证者退出队列升至 773,447 ETH，为 2025 年 12 月以来最大积压，等待约 13 天 10 小时外加约 7.6 天 sweep；进入队列约 27 天。
timeline.text_en: Ethereum’s validator exit queue reached 773,447 ETH, the largest backlog since December 2025, implying about a 13-day 10-hour exit wait plus a 7.6-day sweep; the entry queue is about 27 days.

timeline.text_zh: 链上分析师报告约19个MetaMask验证者疑似遭攻击，奖励费用被转入Tornado Cash资助的地址；约1.7万个验证者主动退出，涉及约52.3万枚ETH，但攻击者实际窃取奖励仅约0.36 ETH；仍有部分疑似受影响验证者未退出。
timeline.text_en: On-chain analyst reports about 19 MetaMask validators appear compromised with reward fees diverted to a Tornado Cash-funded address; roughly 17,000 validators (~523k ETH) voluntarily exited, though only ~0.36 ETH was actually stolen; some suspected affected validators remain unexited.

timeline.text_zh: 新增：约821个可能受影响的验证者仍处于活跃状态，受损的验证者签名密钥可能带来残余罚没（slashing）风险；MetaMask表示其质押服务为非托管且不控制用户提款密钥。
timeline.text_en: New: about 821 potentially affected validators remain active, and compromised validator signing keys could pose residual slashing risk; MetaMask said its staking service is non-custodial and it does not control users' withdrawal keys.

ranking.title_zh: 美国参议院报告指控Tether为伊朗制裁规避提供金融生命线，Tether在华盛顿的游说活动因此受阻
ranking.title_en: Tether is a ‘lifeline’ for Iranian regime, Senate Dems say in new report
ranking.summary_zh: 彭博社报道称，Tether在华盛顿的游说活动因其与伊朗相关制裁问题的关联而受到审查，变得更加复杂。
ranking.summary_en: Bloomberg reports that Tether's lobbying campaign in Washington is being complicated by scrutiny over its exposure to Iran-linked sanctions issues.
ranking.latest_update_zh: 彭博社报道称，Tether在华盛顿的游说活动因其与伊朗相关制裁问题的关联而受到审查，变得更加复杂。
ranking.latest_update_en: Bloomberg reports that Tether's lobbying campaign in Washington is being complicated by scrutiny over its exposure to Iran-linked sanctions issues.
ranking.background_zh: 该参议院小组委员会一直在就加密货币在伊朗影子银行网络及其他非法金融活动中的作用进行持续调查，参议员Richard Blumenthal曾于2026年6月公开就Tether在伊朗影子银行中的角色提出质询。2025年9月，美国财政部制裁了多名伊朗金融从业者以及香港和阿联酋的十余家实体，指其协助转移伊朗石油销售所得的1亿美元加密货币。2026年4月，在OFAC与美国执法部门提供规避制裁证据后，Tether冻结了两个与伊朗中央银行相关、位于Tron上的地址共3.44亿美元USDT。《华尔街日报》最先报道了这份新的参议院文件。
ranking.background_en: The Senate panel has been conducting an ongoing inquiry into cryptocurrency's role in the Iranian shadow banking network and other illicit financial operations, and Senator Richard Blumenthal publicly probed Tether on its role in Iranian shadow banking in June 2026. In September 2025, the U.S. Treasury sanctioned Iranian financiers and more than a dozen entities in Hong Kong and the UAE for allegedly facilitating $100 million in cryptocurrency transfers from Iranian oil sales. In April 2026, Tether froze $344 million in USDT across two Tron addresses tied to Iran's central bank after OFAC and U.S. law enforcement presented evidence of sanctions evasion. The Wall Street Journal first reported on the new Senate document.
ranking.latest_summary_zh: Bloomberg reports that Tether's lobbying campaign in Washington is being complicated by scrutiny over its exposure to Iran-linked sanctions issues.
ranking.latest_summary_en: Bloomberg reports that Tether's lobbying campaign in Washington is being complicated by scrutiny over its exposure to Iran-linked sanctions issues.
ranking.discussion_zh: USDT是规模最大的美元稳定币，也是交易结算与DeFi流动性的主要载体，因此将其与规避制裁相联系的指控，会使发行方以及处理伊朗相关资金流的交易所和交易对手面临合规与执法压力。此类正式的国会调查结论可能转化为更严格的钱包筛查要求或对相关地址的限制，这正是不稳定币流动性与市场情绪可能受到影响的传导渠道。
ranking.discussion_en: USDT is the largest dollar-pegged stablecoin and a dominant venue for trading settlement and DeFi liquidity, so allegations linking it to sanctions evasion put its issuer and the exchanges and counterparties that handle Iran-linked flows in the path of compliance and enforcement pressure. Formal congressional findings of this kind can translate into tighter wallet-screening demands or restrictions on affected addresses, which is the channel through which stablecoin liquidity and market sentiment could be affected.

timeline.text_en: Democratic staff on the Senate Permanent Subcommittee on Investigations released a report finding that 84% of 846 crypto wallets sanctioned over links to Iran and its proxies transacted exclusively or nearly exclusively in Tether's USDT, prompting Tether to cite $550 million in Iran-related freezes this year.

timeline.text_zh: 参议院调查人员将报告发现提交给财政部和司法部，并详细指出超过3460万美元的USDT在2023年6月以色列扣押通知后、2024年3月冻结前从与Tawfiq al-Law相关的34个钱包中流出；Tether则继续强调2026年的冻结行动，包括4月的3.44亿美元和7月的1.3亿美元。
timeline.text_en: Senate investigators referred the report findings to Treasury and Justice and detailed that over $34.6 million in USDT moved out of 34 wallets linked to Tawfiq al-Law after a June 2023 Israeli seizure notice but before they were frozen in March 2024; Tether continued to point to 2026 freezes including $344 million in April and $130 million in July.

timeline.text_zh: Tether 表示，其在 2026 年协助冻结了近 5.5 亿美元与伊朗相关的 USDT，其中包括超过 3.44 亿美元与伊朗中央银行相关的资金。与此同时，参议院民主党调查人员发布报告，指称 USDT 已成为伊朗影子银行网络的核心，并呼吁对该发行方进行审查。
timeline.text_en: Tether said it helped freeze nearly $550 million in Iran-linked USDT in 2026, including over $344 million tied to the Central Bank of Iran, as Senate Democratic investigators released a report alleging USDT had become central to Iran's shadow banking network and called for scrutiny of the issuer.

timeline.text_zh: Tether回应参议院报告，称已协助当局冻结近5.5亿美元与伊朗相关的USDT。
timeline.text_en: Tether responded to the Senate report, saying it helped authorities freeze nearly $550 million in Iran-linked USDT.

ranking.background_zh: GPT-6 Astra 是 OpenAI 开发的大语言模型。据维基百科，该模型于 2026 年 9 月 3 日先向获批用户开放，次日全面可用，相关报道强调其在计算机和浏览器中独立完成复杂任务的能力。宇树 G1 是宇树科技（Unitree Robotics）的人形机器人，官方介绍其结合力位混合控制与模仿学习、强化学习，可实现对物体的精细操作。具身智能（embodied AI）指通过传感器和模型在物理世界中学习并行动的系統。
ranking.background_en: GPT-6 Astra is a large language model developed by OpenAI; according to Wikipedia it was initially released to approved users on September 3, 2026, with general availability the following day, and coverage highlighted its ability to carry out complex tasks on a computer and in a browser. The Unitree G1 is a humanoid robot from Unitree Robotics, which the company describes as combining force-position hybrid control with imitation and reinforcement learning for precise object manipulation. Embodied AI refers to systems that learn from and act in the physical world through sensors and models.

ranking.title_zh: Bitget 遭朝鲜关联黑客攻击，约3.88亿美元被盗
ranking.title_en: Bitget Suffers DPRK-Linked Hack with Roughly $388M Stolen
ranking.summary_zh: Chainalysis 将 3.87 亿美元的 Bitget 黑客攻击归因于与朝鲜有关的黑客，使 2026 年归因于朝鲜的加密货币盗窃金额超过 10 亿美元，链上记录显示被盗的 XRP 通过 THORChain 进行兑换；Chainalysis 使用内部 AI 加速追踪，且新报道补充 Near Intents 拒绝超 5000 万美元相关兑换后自身遭攻击、THORChain 继续处理、Circle 和 Tether 冻结约 31.8 万美元稳定币。
ranking.summary_en: Chainalysis attributes the $387 million Bitget hack to North Korea-linked hackers, bringing DPRK-attributed crypto theft above $1 billion in 2026, with on-chain records showing the stolen XRP being swapped through THORChain; Chainalysis used in-house AI to accelerate tracing, and reporting adds that Near Intents rejected over $50M in related swaps before being hacked, THORChain kept processing, and Circle and Tether froze about $318k in stablecoins.
ranking.latest_update_zh: Chainalysis 使用内部 AI 加速追踪，将 20 多小时的手动跨链对账压缩至 10 分钟以内；新报道还补充了 Near Intents 拒绝超 5000 万美元相关兑换后自身遭攻击、THORChain 继续处理、Circle 和 Tether 冻结约 31.8 万美元稳定币等洗钱应对细节。
ranking.latest_update_en: Chainalysis used in-house AI to accelerate tracing, compressing 20+ hours of manual bridge reconciliation into under 10 minutes; the report also adds laundering response details: Near Intents rejected over $50M in related swaps before being hacked itself, THORChain kept processing, and Circle and Tether froze about $318,000 in stablecoins.
ranking.background_zh: Bitget 于 2018 年在新加坡成立，早期业务以加密衍生品和跟单交易为主，此后扩展为更综合的交易平台。赵长鹏创立了按交易量计全球最大的加密货币交易所币安，并已卸任首席执行官；他在服完四个月刑期后于 2024 年 9 月获释。赵长鹏的公开表态在交易所行业内持续受到关注。
ranking.background_en: Bitget was founded in Singapore in 2018 and built its early business around crypto derivatives and copy trading before expanding into a broader trading platform. Changpeng Zhao founded Binance, the largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume, and stepped down as CEO; he was released from US custody in September 2024 after serving a four-month sentence. Public statements by CZ continue to draw attention across the exchange industry.
ranking.latest_summary_zh: Chainalysis attributed the $387 million Bitget exchange hack to North Korea-linked actors, using in-house AI to trace the funds across 23 rapid transfers into Ethereum, XRP, Zcash and Tron, pushing Pyongyang's 2026 crypto theft total past $1 billion.
ranking.latest_summary_en: Chainalysis attributed the $387 million Bitget exchange hack to North Korea-linked actors, using in-house AI to trace the funds across 23 rapid transfers into Ethereum, XRP, Zcash and Tron, pushing Pyongyang's 2026 crypto theft total past $1 billion.
ranking.discussion_zh: 该事件使交易所热钱包安全以及跨链桥／兑换洗钱路径持续受到关注，也显示 Circle、Tether 等稳定币发行方能够冻结与被追踪资金相关的余额，这一渠道会影响中心化交易平台的托管与流动性风险，以及用于转移被盗资产的跨链桥与即时兑换服务。Chainalysis 关于 AI 辅助追踪的说法，也关系到合规与分析服务商能以多快速度标记受污染资金流。
ranking.discussion_en: The case keeps exchange hot-wallet security and cross-chain bridge/swap laundering routes in focus, and shows that stablecoin issuers such as Circle and Tether can freeze balances tied to traced funds — a channel that affects custody and liquidity risk for centralized venues and for the bridge and instant-swap services used to move stolen assets. Chainalysis's AI-assisted tracing claim also bears on how quickly tainted flows can be flagged by compliance and analytics providers.

timeline.text_en: CertiK data shows Q3 2026 crypto security losses hit $1.26 billion, with Bitget’s $387.5 million hack accounting for about 31%; the report adds attack details: Bitget detected unauthorized hot-wallet transfers on Sept. 24 and suspended withdrawals, attackers exploited a third-party security product vulnerability to obtain internal credentials and forge withdrawal commands, and SlowMist traced activity to an Aug. 31 zero-day exploit.

ranking.title_zh: 以太坊Glamsterdam升级通过排练里程碑并确认测试网日期
ranking.title_en: Ethereum’s upcoming Glamsterdam upgrade clears rehearsal for a big jump in capacity
ranking.summary_zh: 以太坊 Glamsterdam 升级于 10 月 6 日在 Sepolia 测试网激活，区块 Gas 上限从约 6000 万提升至 2 亿；验证者需升级至 Prysm 7.2.1 等包含新 Gas 上限设置的客户端才能自动生成更大区块。2 亿 Gas 设置目前仅适用于 Sepolia 测试网，Glamsterdam 尚未在以太坊主网激活。
ranking.summary_en: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade activates on Sepolia testnet on October 6, raising the block gas limit from ~60M to 200M; validators need clients like Prysm 7.2.1 with updated gas limit settings to automatically propose larger blocks. The 200M gas setting currently applies only to Sepolia testnet; Glamsterdam is not yet activated on Ethereum mainnet.
ranking.latest_update_zh: 以太坊 Glamsterdam 升级于 10 月 6 日 13:53 UTC 在 Sepolia 测试网激活，区块 Gas 上限从约 6000 万提升至 2 亿；开发者紧急发布 Prysm 7.2.1 验证者客户端，修复区块 Gas 上限设置问题，确保验证者自动生成 2 亿 Gas 区块。
ranking.latest_update_en: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade activates on Sepolia testnet on October 6 at 13:53 UTC, raising the block gas limit from roughly 60 million to 200 million; an emergency Prysm 7.2.1 validator client release fixes gas limit configuration to ensure validators automatically propose 200M gas blocks.
ranking.background_zh: Gas 衡量交易所需的计算工作量，而每个以太坊区块都有 Gas 上限，限制了它能容纳的活动量。提高该上限可以提升吞吐量，但会让区块更难、更昂贵地被校验，因此 Glamsterdam 将其与区块级访问列表（EIP-7928）配套推出：访问列表会预先记录区块将要触及的所有账户与存储位置，让客户端在执行开始前就知道需要加载哪些状态依赖。Glamsterdam 是继 Pectra 之后以太坊的下一个重要协议升级，目标是为网络下一代扩容扫清道路。
ranking.background_en: Gas measures the computing work a transaction requires, and each Ethereum block has a gas limit that caps how much activity it can contain. Raising that limit increases throughput but makes blocks harder and more expensive to verify, which is why Glamsterdam pairs it with block-level access lists (EIP-7928), which record upfront every account and storage slot a block will touch so clients know which state dependencies to load before execution begins. Glamsterdam is Ethereum's next major protocol upgrade after Pectra, aimed at clearing the path for the network's next generation of scaling.
ranking.latest_summary_zh: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade activates on the Sepolia testnet with the block gas limit raised from roughly 60 million to 200 million, prompting an emergency Prysm 7.2.1 validator client release so nodes can automatically propose the larger blocks.
ranking.latest_summary_en: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade activates on the Sepolia testnet with the block gas limit raised from roughly 60 million to 200 million, prompting an emergency Prysm 7.2.1 validator client release so nodes can automatically propose the larger blocks.
ranking.discussion_zh: 以太坊吞吐量升级会影响 ETH 的手续费销毁动态，以及把数据回传主网的 Layer 2 rollup 的经济模型，因为更大的区块空间和更低的拥堵会减少活动高峰期的基础手续费尖峰。但本次进展仅局限于 devnet 和尚在拟议中的测试网部署，因此目前尚未改变主网的供应、质押或流动性状况。
ranking.discussion_en: Ethereum throughput upgrades feed into ETH's fee-burn dynamics and the economics of layer-2 rollups that post data back to mainnet, since more block space and lower congestion reduce base-fee spikes during activity surges. This particular milestone is confined to a devnet and a proposed testnet deployment, so it does not yet alter mainnet supply, staking, or liquidity conditions.

timeline.text_zh: 以太坊基金会宣布 Glamsterdam 升级将于 2026 年 10 月 6 日在 Sepolia 测试网激活（epoch 353,024，slot 11,296,768），要求节点运营商更新执行层与共识层客户端；Hoodi 与主网激活时间尚未确定。
timeline.text_en: The Ethereum Foundation announced that the Glamsterdam upgrade will activate on the Sepolia testnet on October 6, 2026 (epoch 353,024, slot 11,296,768), requiring node operators to update execution and consensus clients; Hoodi and mainnet activation dates remain undecided.

timeline.text_zh: 以太坊开发者确认了Glamsterdam测试网日期，同时警告攻击者可能利用免费测试以太币和一次性构建者身份，通过扣留交易载荷来扰乱Sepolia区块拍卖。
timeline.text_en: Ethereum developers confirmed Glamsterdam testnet dates while warning that attackers could exploit free test ether and disposable builder identities to disrupt Sepolia block auctions by withholding transaction payloads.

timeline.text_zh:
以太坊 Glamsterdam 升级在新的区块构建规则下于 Devnet-11 测试网持续出块，Nethermind 执行客户端通过了全部 2,302 项性能测试，在 3 分 15 秒内处理了 5,707 亿 Gas（约每秒 29 亿 Gas）。测试网上线约一小时后，区块 Gas 上限从 6,000 万提高到 2 亿，为拟定的 10 月 6 日 Sepolia 公共测试网部署做准备。

Glamsterdam 引入的区块级访问列表让客户端可以并行地预取数据、同时校验互不相关的交易，而不再按顺序处理，这有望让以太坊在每个区块中容纳更多支付、代币兑换等活动，并在网络拥堵时缓手续费尖峰。该升级还把构建者与验证者之间的交接及其支付纳入以太坊自身的协议规则，从而减少对外部中继服务的依赖。

2 亿 Gas 上限目前仅是测试设置，尚未成为以太坊主网的承诺，而 Devnet-11 被设计为不包含故意攻击的受控演练；10 月 6 日的 Sepolia 部署日期仍需正式确认。Glamsterdam 还将区块数据在网络中传播的时间窗口从约 2 秒延长到 9 秒，使验证者有更充裕的时间接收并校验该升级所支持的大区块；此外，Nethermind 的基准测试衡量的是客户端执行速度，而非整个网络的性能。
timeline.text_en: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade cleared a key rehearsal milestone, with Nethermind passing all 2,302 performance tests and the test network raising its block gas limit toward 200 million ahead of a proposed October 6 Sepolia deployment.

ranking.title_zh: OpenAI再公布一批数学突破成果
ranking.title_en: OpenAI drops another batch of mathematical breakthroughs
ranking.summary_zh: OpenAI 公开了由未发布前沿模型生成的 722 篇数学手稿，覆盖 372 组关联结果，并宣称在多个长期未解问题上取得进展；部分结果已有 Lean 形式化证明，但验证程度不一致，AGMAI 未背书，数学界正在验收。
ranking.summary_en: OpenAI published 722 mathematics manuscripts generated by an unreleased frontier model, spanning 372 result families and claiming progress on several long-standing open problems; some results have Lean formal proofs, but verification is inconsistent, AGMAI has not endorsed them, and the mathematics community is reviewing them.
ranking.latest_update_zh: 新增细节：这批手稿涉及 Unique Games 猜想、准黎曼猜想、CM 阿贝尔簇上的有理 Hodge 猜想和自由群因子问题等具体结果；部分结果附有 Lean 形式化证明，但整体验证程度不一致，独立数学顾问组 AGMAI 未为结果背书。
ranking.latest_update_en: Additional details emerged: the manuscripts address specific results including the Unique Games conjecture, a quasi-Riemann hypothesis, the rational Hodge conjecture for CM abelian varieties, and the free group factor problem; some have Lean formal proofs, but verification is inconsistent and the independent math advisory group AGMAI has not endorsed the results.
ranking.background_zh: OpenAI released a batch of 722 manuscripts spanning 372 result families containing solutions to long-standing mathematics problems generated by an unreleased frontier model, continuing a run of AI-driven math breakthroughs that has stirred debate over research ethics.
ranking.background_en: OpenAI released a batch of 722 manuscripts spanning 372 result families containing solutions to long-standing mathematics problems generated by an unreleased frontier model, continuing a run of AI-driven math breakthroughs that has stirred debate over research ethics.
