timeline.text_zh:
Aleph Alpha 发布了 Kolibri，这是一个针对德语和英语优化的开源权重（open-weight）大语言模型，并同步公开了一份技术报告，记录了其数据集与训练方法。报告发布于 aleph-alpha.com/downloads/tech-report.pdf。

这是来自欧洲“主权 AI”实验室的一次开源权重发布，评论者特别指出，该技术报告对数据集构建与训练流程的披露异常详尽，开放程度少见。

随附的技术报告被描述为一份“如何从零构建现代 agentic LLM”的逐步教程，其中包括数据集是如何制作的。
timeline.text_en: Aleph Alpha released Kolibri, an open-weight LLM optimized for German and English, accompanied by a detailed technical report that documents its dataset and training recipe.

ranking.title_zh: 白宫成立「超级智能」工作组，将在120天内评估AI风险与机遇
ranking.title_en: 白宫成立「超级智能」工作组，将在120天内评估AI风险与机遇
ranking.summary_zh: 白宫已成立「超级智能工作组」（SIF），由国家情报总监、联邦贸易委员会主席、战争部研究与工程副部长兼首席技术官、人事管理办公室主任共同领导，向总统和白宫幕僚长汇报，并承担120天内评估AI风险与机遇、协调联邦政府工作、确保美国在超级智能领域领先的任务。
ranking.summary_en: The White House has formed a 'Superintelligence Working Group' (SIF), co-led by the Director of National Intelligence, FTC Chair, DoD Under Secretary for Research and Engineering/CTO, and OPM Director, reporting to the President and White House Chief of Staff, tasked with a 120-day assessment of AI risks and opportunities, coordinating federal efforts, and preserving US leadership in superintelligence.
ranking.latest_update_zh: 新增工作组的领导层构成：由国家情报总监、联邦贸易委员会主席、战争部研究与工程副部长兼首席技术官、人事管理办公室主任共同领导，并向总统和白宫幕僚长汇报。
ranking.latest_update_en: Added the working group's leadership composition: co-led by the Director of National Intelligence, FTC Chair, DoD Under Secretary for Research and Engineering/CTO, and OPM Director, reporting to the President and White House Chief of Staff.
ranking.background_zh: The White House has formed a 'Super Intelligence Force' chaired by the Director of National Intelligence, tasking it with a 120-day assessment of AI risks and opportunities, federal agency roles, and US leadership in superintelligence while guarding against over-regulation and regulatory capture.
ranking.background_en: The White House has formed a 'Super Intelligence Force' chaired by the Director of National Intelligence, tasking it with a 120-day assessment of AI risks and opportunities, federal agency roles, and US leadership in superintelligence while guarding against over-regulation and regulatory capture.
ranking.latest_summary_zh: President Trump announced the formation of a Superintelligence Working Group (SIF) to coordinate federal government efforts and preserve US leadership in superintelligence, led by the Director of National Intelligence, the FTC chair, a Defense Department R&E official and the OPM director, reporting to the President and White House Chief of Staff.
ranking.latest_summary_en: President Trump announced the formation of a Superintelligence Working Group (SIF) to coordinate federal government efforts and preserve US leadership in superintelligence, led by the Director of National Intelligence, the FTC chair, a Defense Department R&E official and the OPM director, reporting to the President and White House Chief of Staff.

timeline.text_zh: 新增工作组的领导层构成：由国家情报总监、联邦贸易委员会主席、战争部研究与工程副部长兼首席技术官、人事管理办公室主任共同领导，并向总统和白宫幕僚长汇报。
timeline.text_en: Added the working group's leadership composition: co-led by the Director of National Intelligence, FTC Chair, DoD Under Secretary for Research and Engineering/CTO, and OPM Director, reporting to the President and White House Chief of Staff.

timeline.text_zh: 白宫已组建由美国国家情报总监担任主席的“超级智能部队”，责成其在120天内评估AI的风险与机遇、联邦机构的角色以及美国在超级智能领域的领导地位，同时防范过度监管和监管俘获。
timeline.text_en: The White House has formed a 'Super Intelligence Force' chaired by the Director of National Intelligence, tasking it with a 120-day assessment of AI risks and opportunities, federal agency roles, and US leadership in superintelligence while guarding against over-regulation and regulatory capture.

ranking.title_zh: BitMart关闭、提现限制与法院监督重组及资产分配方案
ranking.title_en: BitMart shutdown, withdrawal restrictions and restructuring
ranking.summary_zh: BitMart公布了一项初步的、需经法院批准的计划，以补偿用户约3.195亿美元的储备金缺口，提供多种选择：以法币/稳定币/主流代币进行前端分配，按1美元兑1美元发行的用于追踪被盗资产的恢复代币，或与投资和流动性不足资产回收及潜在未来利润分成挂钩、可在DEX交易的延续代币。
ranking.summary_en: BitMart unveiled a preliminary, court-approval-dependent plan to compensate users for an estimated $319.5M reserve shortfall, offering choices between front-end distributions in fiat/stablecoins/major tokens, 1:1-per-dollar recovery tokens for hack asset tracing, or DEX-tradeable continuation tokens tied to investment and illiquid-asset recoveries and potential future profit sharing.
ranking.latest_update_zh: BitMart公布了一项初步的、需经法院批准的计划，以补偿用户约3.195亿美元的储备金缺口，提供多种选择：以法币/稳定币/主流代币进行前端分配，按1美元兑1美元发行的用于追踪被盗资产的恢复代币，或与投资和流动性不足资产回收及潜在未来利润分成挂钩、可在DEX交易的延续代币。
ranking.latest_update_en: BitMart unveiled a preliminary, court-approval-dependent plan to compensate users for an estimated $319.5M reserve shortfall, offering choices between front-end distributions in fiat/stablecoins/major tokens, 1:1-per-dollar recovery tokens for hack asset tracing, or DEX-tradeable continuation tokens tied to investment and illiquid-asset recoveries and potential future profit sharing.
ranking.background_zh: BitMart在用户报告提现延迟、其财务状况和客户资产处理受到质疑之后，于7月26日宣布停业清算。该交易所随后表示正在权衡重组或重启而非清盘，并承诺在9月9日前拿出路线图。Alvarez & Marsal以企业重组与临时管理著称，其介入通常意味着正式财务重整工作已启动。Echo Base则组织了BitMart非正式债权人委员会，以协调债权主张和与平台的交涉。
ranking.background_en: BitMart announced a wind-down on July 26 after users reported withdrawal delays and scrutiny intensified over its financial condition and handling of customer assets. The exchange later indicated it was weighing a restructuring or restart rather than liquidation and pledged a roadmap by September 9. Alvarez & Marsal is known for corporate restructuring and interim management, so its involvement typically points to formal financial rehabilitation work. Echo Base organized an ad hoc committee of BitMart claimholders to coordinate claims and discussions with the exchange.
ranking.latest_summary_zh: BitMart unveiled a preliminary, court-approval-dependent plan to compensate users for an estimated $319.5M reserve shortfall, offering choices between front-end distributions in fiat/stablecoins/major tokens, 1:1-per-dollar recovery tokens for hack asset tracing, or DEX-tradeable continuation tokens tied to investment and illiquid-asset recoveries and potential future profit sharing.
ranking.latest_summary_en: BitMart unveiled a preliminary, court-approval-dependent plan to compensate users for an estimated $319.5M reserve shortfall, offering choices between front-end distributions in fiat/stablecoins/major tokens, 1:1-per-dollar recovery tokens for hack asset tracing, or DEX-tradeable continuation tokens tied to investment and illiquid-asset recoveries and potential future profit sharing.
ranking.discussion_zh: BitMart 属于中型中心化交易所，直接风险敞口集中在其自身用户与余额之上；传导渠道主要是交易对手与托管风险情绪，可能促使市场审视其他仍背负未了结黑客损失或较大资产负债表缺口的平台。若可 DEX 交易的延续代币最终发行，将形成一个新的二级市场标的，其价值取决于法院监督下追索与变现的进展。
ranking.discussion_en: BitMart is a mid-tier centralized exchange, so direct exposure is concentrated in its own users and balances; the transmission channel is counterparty and custody risk sentiment, which can prompt scrutiny of other venues carrying unresolved hack-related liabilities or large balance-sheet gaps. If the DEX-tradable continuation token is issued, it would create a separate secondary-market instrument whose value would depend on recovery outcomes under the court-supervised process.

timeline.text_zh: BitMart公布了一项初步的、需经法院批准的计划，以补偿用户约3.195亿美元的储备金缺口，提供多种选择：以法币/稳定币/主流代币进行前端分配，按1美元兑1美元发行的用于追踪被盗资产的恢复代币，或与投资和流动性不足资产回收及潜在未来利润分成挂钩、可在DEX交易的延续代币。
timeline.text_en: BitMart unveiled a preliminary, court-approval-dependent plan to compensate users for an estimated $319.5M reserve shortfall, offering choices between front-end distributions in fiat/stablecoins/major tokens, 1:1-per-dollar recovery tokens for hack asset tracing, or DEX-tradeable continuation tokens tied to investment and illiquid-asset recoveries and potential future profit sharing.

timeline.text_zh: BitMart 公布了法院监督下的初步资产分配意向方案：将用户账户余额折算为美元，并提供三种退出选项——即时按比例获得法币/稳定币/主流代币、兑换追偿代币参与被盗资产追索、或兑换可在 DEX 交易的延续代币；未来三至四周将征询前 50 大用户意见。
timeline.text_en: BitMart published an initial court-supervised asset distribution plan: user balances would be converted into USD, with three exit options — immediate pro-rata payout in fiat, stablecoins and major tokens; a recovery token tied to stolen-asset clawbacks; or a DEX-tradable continuation token backed by investment rights and illiquid assets. It will consult its top 50 users over the next three to four weeks.

timeline.text_en: BitMart missed its self-imposed Sept. 9 deadline for a restructuring roadmap and instead appointed Alvarez & Marsal as financial adviser to evaluate its assets and options, with a user feedback portal to launch within five working days and further updates over the next three weeks.

timeline.text_zh: BitMart 聘请 White & Case 评估重组，并承诺最迟 9 月 9 日给出路线图。
timeline.text_en: BitMart engaged White & Case to assess restructuring and said a roadmap was due by Sept. 9.

ranking.title_zh: 英国FCA发布加密授权指引并开放申请窗口
ranking.title_en: UK FCA Publishes Crypto Authorization Guidance and Opens Application Window
ranking.summary_zh: 英国FCA的加密授权申请窗口自2026年9月30日开放，申请截止日为2027年2月28日，新制度将于2027年10月25日生效。及时申请且届时仍在审理中的合格现有服务商可依据临时保存条款继续相关服务并承接新业务，但保护期最长两年且受条件限制；逾期申请者若届时仍在审理中，仅能履行先前合同，不得签订新合同，并进入限制性逐步退出安排。申请不会自动获批，现有反洗钱注册也不会自动转换。
ranking.summary_en: The UK FCA crypto authorization application window opened Sept. 30, 2026, closes Feb. 28, 2027, and the full regime starts Oct. 25, 2027. Eligible existing providers that apply on time and remain undecided at commencement can rely on the temporary saving provision to continue relevant services and take new business subject to conditions and a two-year cap; late applicants still pending at commencement are limited to pre-existing contracts, cannot enter new contracts, and enter restricted run-off. Approval is not automatic, and existing AML registration does not automatically convert.
ranking.latest_update_zh: 新增了FCA临时保存条款（saving provision）的关键细节：在2026年9月30日至2027年2月28日窗口内及时申请且截至2027年10月25日仍在审理中的现有服务商，可在满足条件的情况下继续相关服务并承接新业务，保护期最长两年；而逾期申请者若在制度生效时仍在审理中，则仅能履行先前已签订的合同，不得与现有或新英国客户签订新合同，并进入最长两年的限制性逐步退出安排，且需通知FCA和现有合同方。
ranking.latest_update_en: Added key details of the FCA's temporary saving provision: eligible existing providers that apply within the Sept. 30, 2026–Feb. 28, 2027 window and remain undecided at commencement on Oct. 25, 2027 may continue relevant services and take on new business subject to conditions, with protection capped at two years; late applicants still pending at commencement are limited to pre-existing contracts, cannot enter new contracts with existing or new UK customers, and enter a restricted run-off of up to two years with notification duties to the FCA and existing contract parties.
ranking.background_zh: 英国正在建立一套专门的监管制度，依据《金融服务与市场法》（FSMA）将加密资产纳入FCA的监管范围，而不再仅让公司停留在现有的反洗钱注册框架之下。英国议会已于2月批准相关授权立法，FCA在6月敲定了一揽子规则与指引，并计划在2027年前分阶段过渡。“合格稳定币”指的是试图通过锚定法定货币（如英镑或美元）来维持价值的加密资产。此外，英国上议院以194票对138票通过了一项对《金融服务与市场法》法案的修正案，要求财政部在该法案生效后12个月内制定一项涵盖加密资产、稳定币、代币化证券和数字金融基础设施的数字资产战略。
ranking.background_en: The UK is building a dedicated regulatory regime that brings cryptoassets into the FCA's remit under the Financial Services and Markets Act (FSMA), rather than leaving firms under the existing anti-money-laundering registration framework. Parliament approved the enabling regulations in February and the FCA finalized a package of rules and guidance in June, with a phased transition planned through 2027. "Qualifying stablecoins" refers to cryptoassets that seek to maintain their value by reference to a fiat currency, such as sterling or the US dollar. Separately, the House of Lords voted 194–138 to amend the Financial Services and Markets Bill to require the Treasury to produce a digital asset strategy within 12 months of the bill becoming law.
ranking.latest_summary_zh: The FCA opened applications for the UK's new crypto regime on Sept. 30, 2026, with a Feb. 28, 2027 deadline for the temporary saving provision that lets timely pending applicants keep serving and onboard UK customers ahead of the full Oct. 25, 2027 start, while late applicants are limited to pre-existing contracts.
ranking.latest_summary_en: The FCA opened applications for the UK's new crypto regime on Sept. 30, 2026, with a Feb. 28, 2027 deadline for the temporary saving provision that lets timely pending applicants keep serving and onboard UK customers ahead of the full Oct. 25, 2027 start, while late applicants are limited to pre-existing contracts.
ranking.discussion_zh: 该指引将影响所有涉及英国零售业务的交易场所和服务提供商的市场结构——包括交易平台、交易商、托管方和质押服务安排方——因为获得授权成为继续进入英国市场的前提，而缺乏海外主体豁免使得非英国公司也被纳入监管范围。合规成本与牌照风险是主要的传导渠道，并会对英镑计价稳定币的发行以及FCA另行审查的代币化资产产品产生连带影响。
ranking.discussion_en: The guidance affects market structure for any venue or service provider with UK retail exposure — trading platforms, dealers, custodians and staking arrangers — since authorization becomes a precondition for continued market access, and the absence of an overseas persons exclusion pulls non-UK firms into scope. Compliance cost and licensing risk are the main transmission channels, with knock-on implications for GBP-denominated stablecoin issuance and for tokenized asset products the FCA is reviewing separately.

timeline.text_zh: FCA 最新指引确认为最终指南，明确需要授权的加密活动类别，并说明现有注册/许可不会自动转换；同时给出过渡申请截止日为 2027 年 2 月 28 日。
timeline.text_en: The FCA guidance is now described as final, specifies covered crypto activities, states that existing registrations/permissions will not automatically convert, and adds a Feb. 28, 2027 transitional application deadline.

ranking.title_zh: 美国制裁俄罗斯影子银行网络A7 Network并拟限制其支付
ranking.title_en: US Sanctions A7 Network, Proposes Ban on Sub-Agent Payments
ranking.summary_zh: 美国财政部已制裁俄罗斯关联影子银行网络A7 Network及其A7A5代币，并将其指定为重大跨国犯罪组织；FinCEN提议禁止受管辖金融机构处理涉及A7子代理/前线公司的转移，包括可转换虚拟货币，并估算超180个实体通过A7A5处理了至少1791亿美元。
ranking.summary_en: The US Treasury has sanctioned Russia-linked shadow banking network A7 Network and its A7A5 token, designating A7 as a significant transnational criminal organization; FinCEN proposed barring covered financial institutions from transfers involving A7 sub-agents/front companies, including convertible virtual currency, and estimated more than 180 entities processed at least $179.1 billion in A7A5.
ranking.latest_update_zh: Decrypt报道补充了FinCEN的详细估算：超过180个实体在2025年2月至2026年6月间通过A7A5处理了至少1791亿美元；拟议规则覆盖可转换虚拟货币，并依据《打击俄罗斯洗钱法》第9714条第六项特别措施，约束约34.8万家机构。
ranking.latest_update_en: Decrypt added FinCEN detail estimating that more than 180 entities processed at least $179.1 billion in A7A5 between February 2025 and June 2026; the proposed rule covers convertible virtual currency and uses the sixth special measure under Section 9714 of the Combating Russian Money Laundering Act, binding roughly 348,000 institutions.
ranking.background_zh: 据描述，A7 为俄罗斯个人和实体（包括受制裁对象）提供跨境资金转移，依托俄罗斯和吉尔吉斯斯坦的银行基础设施、位于吉尔吉斯斯坦的加密交易所 Grinex（受制裁的 Garantex 的继任者）以及第三国的壳公司网络。A7 发行与卢布挂钩的稳定币 A7A5。信息韧性中心（Centre for Information Resilience）2025 年 10 月的报告将 A7 利用境外壳公司和本票的做法描述为一种贸易洗钱，并称 A7 宣称其“付款公司”网络中有 30 多家壳公司。
ranking.background_en: A7 is described as enabling cross-border money transfers to Russian individuals and entities, including those under sanctions, using bank infrastructure in Russia and Kyrgyzstan, the Kyrgyzstan-based crypto exchange Grinex (a successor to the sanctioned Garantex), and a network of shell companies in third countries. It issues the ruble-pegged stablecoin A7A5. An October 2025 report by the Centre for Information Resilience described A7's use of foreign shell companies and promissory notes as a form of trade-based money laundering, and said A7 claims over 30 shell companies in its network of "payer companies."
ranking.latest_summary_zh: The U.S. Treasury's OFAC designated Russia's A7 Network a transnational criminal organization and FinCEN proposed barring American financial institutions from any transfers — including convertible virtual currency — involving its front companies, which it says processed over $179 billion in the ruble-backed A7A5 token.
ranking.latest_summary_en: The U.S. Treasury's OFAC designated Russia's A7 Network a transnational criminal organization and FinCEN proposed barring American financial institutions from any transfers — including convertible virtual currency — involving its front companies, which it says processed over $179 billion in the ruble-backed A7A5 token.
ranking.discussion_zh: 该禁令草案针对的是从非俄罗斯银行账户划出资金的子代理环节，因此直接敞口在于代理行交易对手、加密交易所，以及与 A7A5 或 Grinex 相关的卢布锚定稳定币结算通道，传导渠道是合规与去风险压力，而非协议规则的变化。此前有报道称 A7 相关资金流经全球银行，这也意味着处理相关交易对手的机构面临更高的筛查风险。
ranking.discussion_en: The proposed prohibition targets the sub-agent layer that routes payments out of non-Russian bank accounts, so the direct exposure sits with correspondent-banking counterparties, crypto exchanges and ruble-pegged stablecoin settlement rails linked to A7A5 or Grinex, transmitted through compliance and de-risking pressure rather than any change to protocol rules. A7-linked flows reported through global banks also point to heightened screening risk for institutions handling related counterparties.

timeline.text_en: The US Treasury designated A7 Network as a significant transnational criminal organization, expanding blocking sanctions from individual companies to the broader payment network, while FinCEN proposed barring covered financial institutions from transmitting funds involving identified A7 sub-agents.

timeline.text_zh: 美国财政部制裁与俄罗斯有关联的影子银行网络A7 Network及其以卢布为支撑的A7A5代币，称其涉及超过170亿美元的转账和规避制裁行为，同时FinCEN提议限制通过其代理网络进行的转账，并发布了风险提示。
timeline.text_en: The US Treasury sanctioned Russia-linked shadow banking network A7 Network and its ruble-backed A7A5 token, citing over $17 billion in transfers and sanctions evasion, while FinCEN proposed restricting transfers through its correspondent network and issued a risk advisory.

timeline.text_zh:
美国对与俄罗斯相关的支付网络 A7 Network 实施制裁，美国财政部金融犯罪执法网络（FinCEN）同时提出一项规则草案，拟禁止涉及该网络“子代理”（Sub-Agents）的资金汇付。FinCEN 表示，2025 年 1 月至 2026 年 6 月期间，A7 的子代理处理了超过 170 亿美元的美元计价交易。

该规则草案把美国的限制范围从 A7 本身扩大到在 A7 相关发票和付款指令中充当签约方或付款方的境外子代理；FinCEN 称这一层被用来从非俄罗斯银行账户转移资金。该付款禁令目前仍属提案，尚未生效。

根据 FinCEN 的规则制定提案通知，A7 Network 会指派境外子代理作为发票、销售协议和付款指令上的签约方或付款方，从而使款项能够通过代理行和 SWIFT 渠道从非俄罗斯银行账户支付。该措施与美国财政部代号“Operation Economic Outcast”的行动一并公布。
timeline.text_en: The US sanctioned the A7 Network for laundering illicit proceeds and proposed a new rule barring payments to its sub-agents, citing more than $17 billion in dollar-denominated transactions processed from January 2025 through June 2026.

ranking.title_zh: Arbitrum因紧急安全行动暂停新的Stylus激活
ranking.title_en: Arbitrum Pauses New Stylus Activations in Emergency Security Action
ranking.summary_zh: Arbitrum已于10月2日通过安全委员会紧急暂停Arbitrum One和Nova上的新Stylus激活，原因是通过手写WebAssembly进行的AI辅助攻击风险上升。现有Stylus程序可继续运行并续期，普通Solidity合约不受影响；暂停通过提高激活Gas费实现，无需升级ArbOS。未发现可盗取用户资金的攻击。BoLD一步证明防护机制可在接受矛盾证明时延迟未确认的提款，但需满足冲突条件才会暂停结算。恢复激活的日期未定。
ranking.summary_en: Arbitrum paused new Stylus activations on Arbitrum One and Nova on October 2 via Security Council emergency action, citing rising risks from AI-assisted attacks via hand-crafted WebAssembly. Existing Stylus programs keep running and can be renewed; ordinary Solidity contracts unaffected. Pause implemented by raising activation gas to prohibitively expensive level, no ArbOS upgrade. No attack enabling theft of user funds discovered. BoLD one-step proof guard can delay unconfirmed withdrawals if conflicting proofs accepted, but pause of settlement depends on condition. No date for restoring activations.
ranking.latest_update_zh: 新报道补充了暂停范围（Arbitrum One和Nova）、原因（AI辅助攻击通过手写WebAssembly）、通过提高激活Gas费至天文数字实现暂停、无需升级ArbOS、现有Stylus程序可继续续期、未发现可盗取用户资金的攻击、BoLD防护条件等细节。
ranking.latest_update_en: New report adds details: pause applies to Arbitrum One and Nova; attributed to AI-assisted attacks via hand-crafted WebAssembly; implemented by raising activation gas to prohibitively expensive level; no ArbOS upgrade; existing Stylus programs can use keepalive renewal; no attack enabling theft of user funds discovered; BoLD guard condition.
ranking.background_zh: Stylus是Arbitrum的智能合约系统，允许开发者使用可编译为WebAssembly的语言（如Rust、C和C++）编写兼容EVM的合约。BoLD（Bounded Liquidity Delay，有界流动性延迟）是Arbitrum的争议协议，用于实现无需许可的验证，目前已部署在Arbitrum One、Arbitrum Nova和Arbitrum Sepolia上。
ranking.background_en: Stylus is Arbitrum's smart contract system that lets developers write EVM-compatible contracts in languages compiling to WebAssembly, such as Rust, C and C++. BoLD (Bounded Liquidity Delay) is Arbitrum's dispute protocol enabling permissionless validation, and it is active on Arbitrum One, Arbitrum Nova and Arbitrum Sepolia.
ranking.latest_summary_zh: Arbitrum's Security Council paused new Stylus contract activations across Arbitrum One and Nova on October 2, citing increasingly sophisticated AI-assisted attacks via hand-crafted WebAssembly, while already-active Stylus programs and ordinary Solidity contracts continue to operate.
ranking.latest_summary_en: Arbitrum's Security Council paused new Stylus contract activations across Arbitrum One and Nova on October 2, citing increasingly sophisticated AI-assisted attacks via hand-crafted WebAssembly, while already-active Stylus programs and ordinary Solidity contracts continue to operate.
ranking.discussion_zh: Arbitrum是规模最大的Layer 2网络之一，因此暂停新的Stylus激活会影响面向开发者的合约部署流程，而BoLD防护机制则涉及提款与跨链桥环节，未确认的提款可能被放慢。市场反应主要通过ARB情绪以及用户和开发者对Arbitrum跨链桥延迟的信心传导。
ranking.discussion_en: Arbitrum is one of the largest Layer 2 networks, so a pause on new Stylus activations affects the developer-facing contract deployment pipeline, while the BoLD guard touches the withdrawal and bridging segment where unconfirmed exits could be slowed. Any market reaction would transmit mainly through sentiment toward ARB and through user and developer confidence in Arbitrum bridge latency.

timeline.text_zh:
Arbitrum已作为紧急安全措施暂停新的Stylus激活。此外，一项新的BoLD防护机制若接受相互矛盾的证明，可能会延迟尚未确认的提款。

此次暂停使新的Stylus合约无法在Arbitrum上激活，而现有合约仍可继续运行和续期；同时BoLD防护机制引入了一条新路径，可能使等待确认的提款被延迟。

现有活跃合约仍可继续运行和续期。此次行动中没有用户资金损失的报道。
timeline.text_en: Arbitrum paused new Stylus activations as an emergency security measure, while a new BoLD guard could delay unconfirmed withdrawals if contradictory proofs are accepted.

ranking.title_zh: Core Lightning 建议节点运营者因未修补漏洞下线
ranking.title_en: Core Lightning Advises Node Operators to Go Offline Over Unpatched Vulnerability
ranking.summary_zh: 攻击者正积极针对未修补的 Core Lightning 节点；运行 26.06.7 或更早版本的操作者被敦促立即升级，此前关于验证 Docker 镜像摘要的指示仍然适用。
ranking.summary_en: Attackers are actively targeting unpatched Core Lightning nodes; operators on version 26.06.7 or earlier are urged to upgrade immediately, and prior instructions to verify Docker image digests remain relevant.
ranking.latest_update_zh: Core Lightning 收到攻击者正积极针对未修补节点发起攻击的报告，并敦促运行 26.06.7 或更早版本的操作者立即升级至最新版本。

ranking.background_zh: Core Lightning（CLN）开发者已告知节点运营者让其节点下线，因为存在一个严重且尚未修补的漏洞。修复后的二进制文件尚未发布，细节目前处于两周的保密期（embargo）内。
ranking.background_en: Core Lightning (CLN) developers have told node operators to take their nodes offline because of a critical unpatched vulnerability. The fixed binaries have not yet been released, and details are under a two-week embargo.
ranking.latest_summary_zh: Core Lightning urged node operators on version 26.06.7 or earlier to upgrade immediately after receiving reports that attackers are actively targeting unpatched nodes.
ranking.latest_summary_en: Core Lightning urged node operators on version 26.06.7 or earlier to upgrade immediately after receiving reports that attackers are actively targeting unpatched nodes.

ranking.title_zh: Zano 在 Gateway Address 漏洞利用后回滚区块链一个月
ranking.title_en: Zano rolls blockchain back a month after Gateway Address exploit
ranking.summary_zh: Zano 已确认 Gateway Address 漏洞被利用铸造 3690 万枚未授权 ZANO 及 fUSD，并已回滚约一个月链上历史；恢复工作将主要通过交易所和支付服务执行，交易所将回放被回滚撤销的提款，团队将贷记受影响的存款。
ranking.summary_en: Zano has confirmed the Gateway Address exploit minted 36.9M unauthorized ZANO plus fUSD and has rolled back about a month of chain history; recovery is now being carried out primarily through exchanges and payment services, with exchanges to replay withdrawals reversed by the rollback and the team crediting affected deposits.
ranking.latest_update_zh: Zano 发布事后分析，披露攻击者通过 Gateway Address 漏洞在 8 月 29 日和 9 月 25 日分别铸造约 1840 万枚 ZANO，共 3690 万枚未授权 ZANO 及 fUSD；攻击者支付 100 ZANO 注册费并先行测试伪造资产，首次铸造近一个月未被发现。恢复将主要通过交易所和支付服务进行，交易所将回放被回滚撤销的提款，团队将贷记受影响的存款。
ranking.latest_update_en: Zano's post-mortem revealed the attacker exploited the Gateway Address vulnerability to mint about 18.4M ZANO on Aug. 29 and another 18.4M on Sept. 25, totaling 36.9M unauthorized ZANO plus fUSD; the attacker paid a 100 ZANO registration fee, tested a fabricated asset first, and the first mint went unnoticed for nearly a month. Recovery will primarily run through exchanges and payment services, with exchanges to replay withdrawals reversed by the rollback and the team crediting affected deposits.
ranking.background_zh: Zano 是一条以隐私为核心的加密货币，fUSD（Freedom Dollar）是在 Zano 上发行的去中心化、锚定美元的稳定币，其官方说明称该协议没有管理员密钥或黑名单功能。据相关事件报道，该网络从区块 3,833,000 重新启动，删除了约 30 天的链上数据，并推送了热修复，团队称更新后的链运行稳定。Zano 周三表示，正使用开发者基金、团队成员个人资金以及已承诺的捐款来恢复受影响的余额，主要通过与交易所和支付服务商的协作进行：交易所将重放被回滚撤销的提现，团队则为受影响的充值记账。
ranking.background_en: Zano is a privacy-focused cryptocurrency, and fUSD (Freedom Dollar) is a decentralized, dollar-pegged stablecoin issued on Zano that its documentation describes as having no admin keys or blacklist function. According to reports on the incident, the network was restarted from block 3,833,000, removing roughly 30 days of blockchain data, and a hotfix was pushed with the team saying the network is stable on the updated chain. Zano said Wednesday it is working to restore affected balances using its developer fund, team members' personal funds and committed contributions, primarily through exchanges and payment services, with exchanges replaying withdrawals reversed by the rollback and the team crediting affected deposits.
ranking.latest_summary_zh: Zano's post-mortem revealed an attacker exploited its Gateway Address vulnerability to mint 36.9 million unauthorized ZANO and fUSD tokens, which were indistinguishable from legitimate coins and ultimately forced the team to roll the blockchain back by a month.
ranking.latest_summary_en: Zano's post-mortem revealed an attacker exploited its Gateway Address vulnerability to mint 36.9 million unauthorized ZANO and fUSD tokens, which were indistinguishable from legitimate coins and ultimately forced the team to roll the blockchain back by a month.
ranking.discussion_zh: 此次漏洞直接冲击 ZANO 与 fUSD 的供应完整性，风险传导路径主要经由已上线或托管这些代币的交易所与支付服务商——它们需要重新对账被回滚撤销的提现与充值——以及持有 fUSD、其余额取决于重启后链上状态的用户。由于 Zano 属于较小市值网络，影响主要集中在该生态的流动性以及市场对隐私币和稳定币协议安全的情绪，而非更广泛的市场结构。
ranking.discussion_en: The exploit directly hits the supply integrity of ZANO and fUSD, so exposure runs through exchanges and payment services that listed or custody the tokens and must now reconcile withdrawals and deposits reversed by the rollback, plus fUSD holders whose balances depend on the restarted chain state. Because Zano is a smaller-cap network, the transmission is concentrated in that ecosystem's liquidity and in sentiment toward privacy-coin and stablecoin protocol security rather than broader market structure.

ranking.title_zh: Aave 提议设立法律实体以将协议知识产权置于 DAO 治理之下
ranking.title_en: Aave Proposes Legal Entity to Place Protocol IP Under DAO Governance
ranking.summary_zh: Aave 提议设立一个专门的法律实体，代表其 DAO 持有该协议的知识产权，这是 DeFi 最大借贷协议之一的结构性治理变更。
ranking.summary_en: Aave has proposed establishing a dedicated legal entity to hold the protocol's intellectual property on behalf of its DAO, a structural governance change for one of DeFi's largest lending protocols.
ranking.latest_update_zh: Aave 提议设立一个专门的法律实体，代表其 DAO 持有该协议的知识产权，这是 DeFi 最大借贷协议之一的结构性治理变更。
ranking.latest_update_en: Aave has proposed establishing a dedicated legal entity to hold the protocol's intellectual property on behalf of its DAO, a structural governance change for one of DeFi's largest lending protocols.
ranking.background_zh: Aave 是一个非托管的 DeFi 借贷协议，利率由供需算法决定，是规模最大的去中心化借贷协议之一。基金会等法律载体被普遍用于让 DAO 持有和保护商标、域名等知识产权，并与链下世界互动，同时协议仍由链上治理运行。
ranking.background_en: Aave is a non-custodial DeFi lending protocol where interest rates are set algorithmically by supply and demand, and it is among the largest decentralized lending protocols. Legal wrappers such as foundations are commonly used so that a DAO can hold and protect intellectual property like trademarks and domain names and interact with the off-chain world, while on-chain governance continues to run the protocol.
ranking.latest_summary_zh: Aave has proposed establishing a dedicated legal entity to hold the protocol's intellectual property on behalf of its DAO, a structural governance change for one of DeFi's largest lending protocols.
ranking.latest_summary_en: Aave has proposed establishing a dedicated legal entity to hold the protocol's intellectual property on behalf of its DAO, a structural governance change for one of DeFi's largest lending protocols.
ranking.discussion_zh: 该提案涉及 Aave 品牌与代码库的法律所有权，而非协议流动性，因此市场传导路径主要在治理与法律结构层面：提案声明 AAVE 持有者的现有投票权不变，而更清晰的法律载体可能影响交易对手、贡献者与机构参与者同协议互动的方式。ARFC 阶段本身不会改变抵押资产、上币安排或代币供应。
ranking.discussion_en: The proposal concerns the legal ownership of Aave's brand and codebase rather than protocol liquidity, so any market transmission runs through governance and legal structure: AAVE holders' existing voting rights are stated as unchanged, while a clearer legal wrapper could affect how counterparties, contributors and institutional participants engage with the protocol. The ARFC stage itself does not alter collateral, listings or token supply.
ranking.market_impact_zh: 该提案涉及 Aave 品牌与代码库的法律所有权，而非协议流动性，因此市场传导路径主要在治理与法律结构层面：提案声明 AAVE 持有者的现有投票权不变，而更清晰的法律载体可能影响交易对手、贡献者与机构参与者同协议互动的方式。ARFC 阶段本身不会改变抵押资产、上币安排或代币供应。
ranking.market_impact_en: The proposal concerns the legal ownership of Aave's brand and codebase rather than protocol liquidity, so any market transmission runs through governance and legal structure: AAVE holders' existing voting rights are stated as unchanged, while a clearer legal wrapper could affect how counterparties, contributors and institutional participants engage with the protocol. ranking.title_zh: Supabase将收购Turso
ranking.title_en: Supabase is acquiring Turso
ranking.summary_zh: Supabase 宣布收购 Turso，理由是为 AI Agent 提供可即时按需创建的独立数据库；两家产品暂不合并，Turso 数据库继续开源，计划逐步打通（小任务用 Turso，规模变大后迁移到 Supabase 的 Postgres），Turso 创始人 Glauber Costa 将加入 Supabase 负责 Agent 服务，收购金额未公布。
ranking.summary_en: Supabase announced it is acquiring Turso to give every AI agent an instantly provisioned database; the products remain separate for now (Turso Database stays open source), with gradual integration planned (small agent tasks on Turso, scaling into Supabase's Postgres), Turso founder Glauber Costa joining Supabase to lead agent-related services, and the deal value undisclosed.
ranking.latest_update_zh: 补充收购细节：收购意在服务 AI Agent（Supabase 每周新建超 100 万个数据库，约 70% 来自 Agent/AI 工具），Turso 的 Rust 版 SQLite 架构可单机管理数百万按需数据库；两家产品暂不合并（Supabase 继续做 Postgres，Turso 继续做 SQLite，现有数据库/API/工作流不变，Turso Database 继续开源），计划逐步打通；Turso 创始人 Glauber Costa 将加入 Supabase 负责 Agent 相关服务；收购金额未披露。
ranking.latest_update_en: Added deal details: the acquisition targets AI-agent workloads (Supabase says over 1M databases are created weekly, ~70% from agents/AI tools), Turso's Rust SQLite architecture can manage millions of on-demand databases per server; the products will not be merged immediately (Supabase stays on Postgres, Turso stays on SQLite, existing databases/APIs/workflows unchanged, Turso Database remains open source) with gradual integration planned; Turso founder Glauber Costa will join Supabase to lead agent-related services; deal value undisclosed.
ranking.background_zh: Supabase announced it is acquiring Turso, the company behind the libSQL/Turso SQLite-compatible database, prompting community debate about Turso's technical future, performance problems, and open-source self-hosting options.
ranking.background_en: Supabase announced it is acquiring Turso, the company behind the libSQL/Turso SQLite-compatible database, prompting community debate about Turso's technical future, performance problems, and open-source self-hosting options.
ranking.latest_summary_zh: Supabase acquired database company Turso, whose Rust-based SQLite implementation can spin up millions of on-demand cloud databases per server, to give every AI agent its own instantly provisioned database, with the two products kept separate for now (Supabase on Postgres, Turso on SQLite, still open source) and gradual integration planned.
ranking.latest_summary_en: Supabase acquired database company Turso, whose Rust-based SQLite implementation can spin up millions of on-demand cloud databases per server, to give every AI agent its own instantly provisioned database, with the two products kept separate for now (Supabase on Postgres, Turso on SQLite, still open source) and gradual integration planned.

ranking.title_zh: IMF批准向萨尔瓦多拨款并豁免比特币违规
ranking.title_en: IMF Approves Disbursement to El Salvador and Waives Bitcoin Breach
ranking.summary_zh: IMF批准向萨尔瓦多拨付1.38亿美元，此前已接受比特币豁免，但仍期望该国停止在已记录捐赠之外的进一步BTC购买，并完全清退剩余的Chivo敞口。
ranking.summary_en: The IMF approved a $138 million disbursement for El Salvador after accepting a Bitcoin waiver, while still expecting the country to halt further BTC purchases beyond documented donations and fully unwind its remaining Chivo exposure.
ranking.latest_update_zh: 萨尔瓦多承诺不再进行超出已记录捐赠范围的比特币积累，并继续降低政府在比特币相关活动中的参与度，同时加强透明度披露及监管框架建设。
ranking.latest_update_en: El Salvador committed to stop accumulating BTC beyond recorded donations and to reduce government involvement in Bitcoin-related activities, with continued transparency and regulatory framework improvements.
ranking.background_zh: The IMF approved a $139 million disbursement to El Salvador under its $1.4 billion Extended Fund Facility and granted a waiver for the country's breach of program conditions limiting further bitcoin purchases.

ranking.latest_summary_en: The IMF approved a $138 million disbursement to El Salvador under its $1.4 billion EFF program after granting a waiver on Bitcoin accumulation limits, with El Salvador committing to stop accumulating BTC beyond recorded donations and to reduce government involvement in Bitcoin-related activities.

timeline.text_zh: 萨尔瓦多承诺不再进行超出已记录捐赠范围的比特币积累，并继续降低政府在比特币相关活动中的参与度，同时加强透明度披露及监管框架建设。
timeline.text_en: El Salvador committed to stop accumulating BTC beyond recorded donations and to reduce government involvement in Bitcoin-related activities, with continued transparency and regulatory framework improvements.

timeline.text_en: The IMF approved a $139 million disbursement to El Salvador under its $1.4 billion Extended Fund Facility and granted a waiver for the country's breach of program conditions limiting further bitcoin purchases.

ranking.title_zh: 华尔街监管机构就投资顾问加密资产托管规则提出提案
ranking.title_en: Wall Street regulator proposes rules on investment adviser crypto asset custody
ranking.summary_zh: SEC 于2026年10月1日提出的投资顾问加密资产托管规则仍处于提案阶段，新增细节显示该框架覆盖注册投资顾问和受监管基金，并允许特定条件下的自托管；评论期待定，所有条款在最终规则前不生效。
ranking.summary_en: The SEC's Oct. 1, 2026 proposed investment adviser crypto custody rules remain at proposal stage; added details show the framework covers registered investment advisers and regulated funds, permits self-custody under conditions, and has a pending comment period; all provisions are conditional until a final rule.
ranking.latest_update_zh: 新报道补充了 SEC 10月1日提案的具体内容：为注册投资顾问和受监管基金设立加密资产托管框架，允许在特定条件下自托管，并承认州信托公司可作为托管人；评论期60天，条款须待最终规则生效。
ranking.latest_update_en: New report details the SEC's Oct. 1 proposal: creates a crypto custody framework for registered investment advisers and regulated funds, allows self-custody under certain conditions, recognizes state trust companies as custodians, and sets a 60-day comment period; provisions remain conditional until a final rule.
ranking.background_zh: The SEC proposed new rules governing how investment advisers must custody crypto assets, a step that would formalize compliance obligations for firms offering digital-asset exposure to clients.
ranking.background_en: The SEC proposed new rules governing how investment advisers must custody crypto assets, a step that would formalize compliance obligations for firms offering digital-asset exposure to clients.
ranking.latest_summary_zh: The SEC proposed a crypto custody framework allowing investment advisers and regulated funds to hold digital assets, the ninth US agency crypto action since Aug. 18, even as Congress leaves the SEC-CFTC jurisdictional boundary unresolved.
ranking.latest_summary_en: The SEC proposed a crypto custody framework allowing investment advisers and regulated funds to hold digital assets, the ninth US agency crypto action since Aug. 18, even as Congress leaves the SEC-CFTC jurisdictional boundary unresolved.

ranking.title_en: South Korea targets February 2027 rollout for full tokenized securities market
ranking.summary_zh: 韩国已从宣布2027年2月推出代币化证券市场的计划，推进到由金融服务委员会提出具体监管规则并进入公众咨询阶段，规则拟于2027年2月4日生效。
ranking.summary_en: South Korea has moved from announcing a plan for a full tokenized securities market by February 2027 to the Financial Services Commission proposing detailed rules, now in public consultation, with the framework scheduled to take effect on Feb. 4, 2027.
ranking.latest_update_zh: 韩国金融服务委员会提出了代币化证券发行与交易的具体规则，包括发行方最低资本要求、场外交易牌照和零售投资限额，并计划于11月11日前完成公众咨询，规则拟于2027年2月4日生效。
ranking.latest_update_en: South Korea's Financial Services Commission proposed detailed rules for issuing and trading tokenized securities, including minimum capital requirements for issuers, OTC trading licenses and retail investment limits, with public consultation through Nov. 11 and planned effect on Feb. 4, 2027.
ranking.background_zh: South Korea has announced a plan to launch a full tokenized securities market by February 2027, signaling a major regulatory step toward integrating digital assets into traditional finance.
ranking.background_en: South Korea has announced a plan to launch a full tokenized securities market by February 2027, signaling a major regulatory step toward integrating digital assets into traditional finance.

ranking.summary_en: Google unexpectedly released Gemini 4, an 'RSI'-enhanced frontier model positioned as outperforming GPT and Opus and priced at roughly half the cost of Astra.

timeline.text_zh:
谷歌于 2026 年 9 月 30 日（周三）发布 Gemini 4 Argon，将其宣传为迄今最强大的模型，并定位为面向编程与网络安全工作的主力模型。据 CNBC 报道，该模型首先面向选定的网络安全合作伙伴推出，而非全面开放。

这是谷歌在前沿模型竞争中的最新一次发布；据 CNBC 报道，其初始投放仅面向选定的网络安全合作伙伴，而非所有开发者。谷歌将其定位为开发者、专业人士与企业解决难题的伙伴。

谷歌博客称，Gemini 4 Argon 在编程、知识工作、网络安全防御和创意写作方面具备“前沿级能力”。第三方评测机构 Artificial Analysis 将“Gemini 4 Argon (High)”列为智能水平领先的模型之一，并称其相对同类模型定价合理。
timeline.text_en: Google released Gemini 4 'Argon', which it markets as its most powerful model to date and pitches as a workhorse for coding and cybersecurity tasks.

Alternative trading systems (ATS) are non-exchange US trading venues that match buyers and sellers; Bruce ATS is such a venue. Robinhood has been expanding its crypto and derivatives footprint through Robinhood Derivatives and its acquisition of crypto exchange Bitstamp.

timeline.text_en: Robinhood has rolled out 10x leveraged crypto trading to its US user base, extending leveraged derivatives access to mainstream retail customers.

timeline.text_zh:
Robinhood 周二在得克萨斯州休斯敦举行的 HOOD Summit 上公布一系列面向活跃交易者的新产品，包括可执行交易的 AI 智能体、最高提供 10 倍杠杆的加密永续合约，以及部分美国股票和 ETF 的周末交易。平台还将延长期权交易时间、增加日内保证金额度，并推出企业财报事件合约。

若这些产品按描述上线，将扩大美国散户对杠杆加密衍生品和智能体交易的可及范围，使 Robinhood 的业务从现有股票和现货加密进一步延伸。

加密永续合约将通过 Robinhood Derivatives 和 Bitstamp 向符合条件的美国用户提供，BTC 和 ETH 合约最高支持 10 倍杠杆，其他支持资产初期提供 3 倍杠杆。Robinhood Agents 允许用户在应用内选择 OpenAI 或 Anthropic 模型，并授权其访问独立交易账户；平台默认要求用户批准每笔交易，用户可选择关闭该限制，产品上线初期不支持保证金借贷。周末交易则将通过另类交易系统 Bruce ATS 提供，覆盖部分股票和 ETF。
timeline.text_en: Robinhood announced it will offer crypto perpetual futures with up to 10x leverage to eligible US users, weekend trading in select US stocks and ETFs, and AI trading agents powered by user-selected OpenAI or Anthropic models.

ranking.title_zh: Gemini 4 Argon：我们通往前沿智能的下一个时代
ranking.title_en: Gemini 4 Argon: our next era of frontier intelligence
ranking.summary_zh: 谷歌发布了 Gemini 4 Argon，并将其作为新一代旗舰长程模型。单次输出上限从此前 64K tokens 提高到 100 万 tokens。模型暂不向普通用户开放，首批仅通过 Fairwind Program 提供给可信网络安全团队，后续再逐步开放给付费 API 客户和 Google AI Ultra 用户。API 定价初期为每百万输入 tokens 2 美元、输出 10 美元，之后翻倍至 4 美元和 20 美元。官方评测中，Argon 在 DeepSWE v1.1 得 77.9%，高于 GPT-6 Astra 和 Claude Opus 5.5，但在 FrontierSWE、Terminal-Bench 4.0 及部分科学任务上仍落后。谷歌重点强化了网络安全能力，可信防御团队版本甚至会取消部分网络安全限制；正式开放前，谷歌仍在测试滥用、提示词注入和 Agent 越界等风险。
ranking.summary_en: Google released Gemini 4 Argon as its next flagship long-horizon model. Its single-pass output limit jumps from 64K tokens to 1 million tokens. The model is not yet open to ordinary users; initial access is only through the Fairwind Program to trusted cybersecurity teams, with later rollout to paid API customers and Google AI Ultra users. API pricing starts at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, later doubling to $4 and $20. In official evaluations, Argon scores 77.9% on DeepSWE v1.1, ahead of GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5, but still trails on FrontierSWE, Terminal-Bench 4.0 and some scientific tasks. Google emphasized cybersecurity capabilities, with trusted defender versions even removing some cyber restrictions; before formal opening, Google is still testing abuse, prompt injection and agent boundary risks.
ranking.latest_update_zh: 新报道补充了 Gemini 4 Argon 的关键细节：单次输出上限从 64K tokens 提升至 100 万 tokens；首批仅通过 Fairwind Program 向可信网络安全团队开放，后续再逐步开放给付费 API 客户和 Google AI Ultra 用户；API 上线初期按每百万输入 tokens 2 美元、输出 10 美元收费，之后价格翻倍至 4 美元和 20 美元；在 DeepSWE v1.1 得 77.9%，领先 GPT-6 Astra 的 74.1% 和 Claude Opus 5.5 的 74.2%，但在 FrontierSWE、Terminal-Bench 4.0 和部分科学任务上仍落后；网络安全能力被重点强化，可信防御团队版本会取消部分网络安全限制，同时谷歌仍在测试滥用、提示词注入和 Agent 越界等风险。
ranking.latest_update_en: The new report adds key details about Gemini 4 Argon: its single-pass output limit jumps from 64K tokens to 1 million tokens; initial access is only through the Fairwind Program to trusted cybersecurity teams, with later rollout to paid API customers and Google AI Ultra users; API pricing starts at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, later doubling to $4 and $20; it scores 77.9% on DeepSWE v1.1, ahead of GPT-6 Astra's 74.1% and Claude Opus 5.5's 74.2%, but still trails on FrontierSWE, Terminal-Bench 4.0 and some scientific tasks; cybersecurity capabilities are emphasized, with trusted defender versions removing some cyber restrictions, while Google continues testing abuse, prompt injection and agent boundary risks.
ranking.background_zh: Argon 是谷歌 Gemini 旗舰系列的后续产品：Gemini 3 于 11 月发布，而 DeepMind 首席技术官 Koray Kavukcuoglu 担任新设立的谷歌首席 AI 架构师一职，职责是加快公司 AI 技术的产品化。“前沿模型”是产业与政策领域的术语，指处于当前通用人工智能能力最前沿或接近最前沿的模型，而非固定的技术类别。
ranking.background_en: Argon arrives as the successor in Google's Gemini flagship line: Gemini 3 was released in November, and Koray Kavukcuoglu, DeepMind's chief technology officer, holds the newly created role of Google chief AI architect aimed at accelerating productization of the company's AI technology. "Frontier model" is an industry and policy term for a model at or near the current leading edge of general-purpose AI capability, rather than a fixed technical class.
ranking.latest_summary_zh: Google DeepMind released Gemini 4 Argon, a flagship long-horizon model whose single-pass output limit jumps from 64K to 1 million tokens, initially offered only to trusted cybersecurity teams via the Fairwind Program before wider API and consumer rollout.
ranking.latest_summary_en: Google DeepMind released Gemini 4 Argon, a flagship long-horizon model whose single-pass output limit jumps from 64K to 1 million tokens, initially offered only to trusted cybersecurity teams via the Fairwind Program before wider API and consumer rollout.
ranking.discussion_zh: Hacker News 上的评论意见不一。一些人对受限的发布方式提出批评，指出非 Flash 模型再次对普通订阅用户无限期不可用，并质疑付费档位的价值；也有人认为各实验室之间的持续交替领先，削弱了“AI 是赢者通吃、先发优势永不丢失”这一与 Anthropic 的 Dario Amodei 相关的看法。另有用户描述了一次 Gemini 3.8 Flash 的使用经历：该模型将 GDB 附加到 GPU 驱动、逆向内核队列 ioctl 接口，并编写 LD_PRELOAD 垫片，使 ROCm 版 llama.cpp 在 Strix Halo 机器上运行起来。
ranking.discussion_en: Commenters on Hacker News were divided. Several criticized the restricted rollout, noting that a non-Flash model is again unavailable to regular subscribers for an indefinite period and questioning the value of paid tiers, while one argued the steady leapfrogging between labs undercuts the idea — associated with Anthropic's Dario Amodei — that AI is a winner-takes-all field where an early lead is never ceded. Another user described a Gemini 3.8 Flash session in which the model attached GDB to a GPU driver, reverse-engineered a kernel queue ioctl interface and wrote an LD_PRELOAD shim to get ROCm llama.cpp working on a Strix Halo machine.
ranking.market_impact_zh: 与加密市场相关的传导渠道主要是情绪面，而非公告披露的任何集成：大型实验室发布前沿模型往往会推动围绕 AI 相关代币和去中心化算力代币的叙事，尽管该公告本身并未披露与加密市场在托管、流动性、上币或监管方面的任何关联。任何影响都将通过交易者在这类 AI 主题板块上的仓位体现，而非通过目前仍受限的 Gemini 4 Argon 本身的可获得性。
ranking.market_impact_en: The crypto-relevant transmission channel is sentiment rather than any disclosed integration: frontier-model releases from major labs tend to feed narratives around AI-adjacent and decentralized compute tokens, even though the announcement itself discloses no custody, liquidity, listing or regulatory linkage to crypto markets. Any effect would run through trader positioning on those AI-themed segments rather than through Gemini 4 Argon's own availability, which remains restricted.

timeline.text_en: The new report adds key details about Gemini 4 Argon: its single-pass output limit jumps from 64K tokens to 1 million tokens; initial access is only through the Fairwind Program to trusted cybersecurity teams, with later rollout to paid API customers and Google AI Ultra users; API pricing starts at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, later doubling to $4 and $20; it scores 77.9% on DeepSWE v1.1, ahead of GPT-6 Astra's 74.1% and Claude Opus 5.5's 74.2%, but still trails on FrontierSWE, Terminal-Bench 4.0 and some scientific tasks; cybersecurity capabilities are emphasized, with trusted defender versions removing some cyber restrictions, while Google continues testing abuse, prompt injection and agent boundary risks.

timeline.text_zh:
谷歌发布了其新一代前沿 AI 模型 Gemini 4 Argon。谷歌首席 AI 架构师、Google DeepMind 高级副总裁 Koray Kavukcuoglu 表示，该模型在“真实软件工程、法律与金融等企业知识工作，以及网络安全防御等复杂工作流中提供前沿性能”。谷歌目前限制该模型的访问权限，称将继续从早期测试者处收集反馈并迭代护栏机制，之后再向开发者、企业和消费者开放 Argon。

该发布使顶级实验室之间的竞争再添一款旗舰模型，但访问权限仍受限——开发者、企业和消费者目前尚不能普遍使用，谷歌给出的理由是仍在完善护栏机制并收集早期测试者反馈。

谷歌称 Argon 在编程、推理和多模态方面具备能力，并能在企业工作流中持续完成长链条、多步骤任务。Hacker News 评论者引用公告称，Argon 智能体正在谷歌内部将 C/C++ 代码库迁移至 Rust；独立评测机构 Artificial Analysis 将 Gemini 4 Argon（High）列为智能水平领先的模型之一，且相对于同等价位的模型定价合理。
timeline.text_en:
Google unveiled Gemini 4 Argon, its next frontier AI model, which the company says delivers "frontier performance in complex workflows across real-world software engineering, enterprise knowledge work like legal and finance, and cybersecurity defense," according to chief AI architect and Google DeepMind SVP Koray Kavukcuoglu. Google is limiting access to the model for now, saying it will keep gathering feedback from early testers as it iterates on guardrails before making Argon available to developers, enterprises and consumers.

The announcement puts a new flagship model into the top-lab competition, but access remains restricted — developers, enterprises and consumers cannot yet use it generally, with Google citing continued work on guardrails and feedback from early testers as the reason.

Google describes Argon's capabilities across coding, reasoning and multimodality, and its ability to sustain long, multi-step tasks in enterprise workflows. Hacker News commenters quoted the announcement as saying Argon agents are working on migrating C/C++ codebases to Rust across Google; independent evaluator Artificial Analysis rates Gemini 4 Argon (High) as among the leading models in intelligence and reasonably priced relative to models at a similar price point.

featured.summary_zh: Coinbase 已完成 Deribit 整合，成立统一的 Coinbase Global Exchange，并使符合条件的美国客户能够通过受 CFTC 监管的 Coinbase Financial Markets 接入全球加密期权和永续合约流动性；美国机构客户可通过 Coinbase Prime 和 Coinbase Financial Markets 接入，美国零售期权预计今年晚些时候推出。公司还计划年底前重新推出 Coinbase Pro。
featured.summary_en: Coinbase has completed its Deribit integration to form the unified Coinbase Global Exchange and now enables eligible US customers to access global crypto options and perpetual futures liquidity through CFTC-regulated Coinbase Financial Markets; US institutional clients can access via Coinbase Prime and Coinbase Financial Markets, with US retail options expected later this year. It also plans to relaunch Coinbase Pro by year-end.

featured.background_zh: DCO牌照允许机构作为衍生品交易的中央对手方，通过清算与结算交易来降低对手方风险，该牌照由美国CFTC颁发。加密交易所一直在争取此类牌照以将业务从现货拓展至衍生品领域——Gemini旗下的Olympus部门近期也获得了CFTC颁发的DCO牌照。
featured.background_en: A DCO license allows an entity to act as a central counterparty for derivative trades, clearing and settling transactions to reduce counterparty risk, and is issued by the CFTC in the United States. Crypto exchanges have been seeking these licenses to expand beyond spot trading — Gemini's Olympus division recently obtained a DCO license from the CFTC.

featured.latest_summary_en: Coinbase has completed its Deribit integration, letting eligible US customers access global crypto options and perpetual futures liquidity through its CFTC-regulated Coinbase Financial Markets unit, with US retail options expected later this year.

featured.discussion_en: Concentrating options and perpetuals liquidity on a single venue concentrates derivatives order flow, funding and settlement activity, and changes execution and counterparty arrangements for the non-US institutional accounts that trade there through Coinbase Bermuda Limited. Adding equities and pre-IPO markets to the same platform also broadens the product and collateral mix available to those accounts beyond crypto derivatives.

featured.title_zh: ICE与OKX合资公司OKXICE向SEC申请推出24/7代币化美股交易场所
featured.title_en: OKX-ICE Joint Venture Files with SEC for Tokenized Stock Trading
featured.summary_zh:
据报道，纽约证券交易所母公司ICE与加密交易所OKX正筹划提供7×24小时的代币化股票交易，将传统交易所基础设施与加密原生连续交易市场结合。该合作被描述为仍处于早期阶段，尚未得到证实。

若该报道属实，这将把纽约证券交易所的运营方与加密原生交易平台连接起来，是传统交易所基础设施与数字资产市场的一次显著融合。其实际影响取决于相关计划能否走出目前报道中的早期阶段。

相关报道尚未得到ICE或OKX证实，也未披露上线时间、产品结构或监管批准等细节。ICE运营13家受监管交易所和6家清算所，并拥有数字资产托管业务ICE Digital Trust；OKX的前身是2013年成立的同名交易所Okcoin。
featured.summary_en:
ICE, the parent company of the New York Stock Exchange, and crypto exchange OKX are reportedly planning to offer 24/7 tokenized stock trading, combining traditional exchange infrastructure with crypto-native continuous markets. The reported collaboration is described as early-stage and has not been confirmed.

The reported tie-up would connect the operator of the NYSE with a crypto-native trading venue, a notable convergence of traditional exchange infrastructure and digital-asset markets. Any concrete effect depends on whether the plans advance beyond the reported early stage.

The reports remain unconfirmed by ICE or OKX, and no launch date, product structure or regulatory approvals were detailed. ICE operates 13 regulated exchanges and six clearing houses and owns ICE Digital Trust, a digital asset custody business; OKX began in 2013 as the exchange Okcoin.

featured.background_zh: 此次申报之前，SEC 已发布命令，授予临时、有条件的豁免救济——即“创新豁免”——以推动部分代币化股票的链上交易，相关数字资产必须附带完整股东权益，包括分红权和投票权。在授予豁免时，SEC 就隔夜代币化股票交易可能如何影响流动性、定价以及传统市场的开盘、重开和收盘流程征求了公众意见。ICE 与 OKX 此前已组建合资公司 OKXICE，用于搭建连接传统金融与 7×24 小时数字资产市场的基础设施，安德鲁·库莫担任联席主席。
featured.background_en: The filing follows the SEC's order granting temporary, conditional exemptive relief — the "Innovation Exemption" — to facilitate onchain trading of certain tokenized stocks, under which digital assets must carry full shareholder benefits such as dividends and voting rights. In granting the exemption, the SEC sought public comment on how overnight tokenized-stock trading could affect liquidity, pricing and the opening, reopening and closing processes of conventional markets. ICE and OKX previously formed OKXICE as a joint venture to build infrastructure bridging traditional and 24/7 digital asset markets, with Andrew Cuomo as co-chair.

featured.title_zh: CFTC提出CTX与CAM规则，建立联邦加密交易所监管框架
featured.title_en: CFTC Proposes CTX and CAM Rules to Establish Federal Crypto Exchange Framework
featured.summary_zh: CFTC拟议规则建立联邦加密交易框架，其中杠杆交易仅限联邦监管平台，100倍杠杆被明确禁止。
featured.summary_en: The CFTC's proposed rules establish a federal crypto trading framework in which leveraged trading is limited to federally regulated platforms and 100x leverage is explicitly prohibited.
featured.latest_update_zh:
CFTC 公布了一份初步提案，拟通过两项新规——Regulation CTX 与 Regulation CAM——建立加密交易所的联邦许可框架，文件在《联邦公报》刊登后将开启为期 60 天的公众意见征询期。此时距《Clarity 法案》在参议院夭折已有三周，同日 SEC 还批准了 3 倍杠杆的 BTC 和 ETH 基金上市交易。

该计划提出了单一的联邦许可选择，并以是否涉及杠杆来决定谁需要持牌，这是国会未能通过的框架，将允许美国交易平台提供目前无法提供的保证金类产品。不过这是一份征求意见的初步概念文件，并非具有约束力的规则文本。

牌照将覆盖撮合买卖双方、托管客户资金与加密资产、结算交易以及借贷，每项业务需分别获批；交易将通过已受反洗钱规则约束的经纪商进行，且只有这些经纪商或其保荐银行可以提供杠杆。该机构还在考虑储备金证明要求，以及针对易被操纵代币的上市标准；CFTC 主席 Mike Selig 表示，这些规则的目的是防止类似 FTX 的欺诈，而非事后追诉。
featured.latest_update_en: The CFTC published a preliminary plan to federally license and regulate crypto exchanges via proposed Regulations CTX and CAM and opened a 60-day public comment period, while the SEC cleared 3x levered Bitcoin and Ether funds for trading.
featured.background_zh: 参议院未能达到推进《CLARITY 法案》所需的 60 票门槛，该法案本将为数字资产建立法定框架。美国加密交易目前要么适用为其他市场制定的规则，要么适用各州不一的地方牌照。CFTC 的这份通知还否定了该机构在拜登时期对 Kraken、Ooki DAO 和 Uniswap 的执法案件，称其为“以执法代替监管”。
featured.background_en: The Senate failed to reach the 60 votes needed to advance the CLARITY Act, which would have created a statutory framework for digital assets. Crypto trading in the US currently runs under rules built for other markets or under state licenses that vary by state. The CFTC notice also disowns the agency's Biden-era cases against Kraken, Ooki DAO and Uniswap as regulation by enforcement.
featured.latest_summary_zh: The CFTC published a preliminary plan to federally license and regulate crypto exchanges via proposed Regulations CTX and CAM and opened a 60-day public comment period, while the SEC cleared 3x levered Bitcoin and Ether funds for trading.
featured.latest_summary_en: The CFTC published a preliminary plan to federally license and regulate crypto exchanges via proposed Regulations CTX and CAM and opened a 60-day public comment period, while the SEC cleared 3x levered Bitcoin and Ether funds for trading.
featured.discussion_zh: 传导路径在于美国市场准入：联邦牌照将使本土交易所能够上线目前主要在离岸提供的杠杆及永续类产品，涉及交易所股票、在岸永续合约场所及为其撮合交易的经纪商，而更清晰的规则也会降低银行和券商涉足加密业务的门槛。由于该文件只是开启意见征询期，近期影响限于围绕美国受监管场所的情绪与仓位，而非已生效的规则。
featured.discussion_en: The transmission path runs through US market access: a federal license would let domestic exchanges list leveraged and perpetual-style products now largely offered offshore, putting exchange equities, listed perp venues and the brokers routing those trades in scope, with clear rules also lowering the barrier for banks and brokers to touch crypto. Because the document only opens a comment period, near-term effects are confined to sentiment and positioning around US-regulated venues rather than to rules in force.
featured.market_impact_zh: 传导路径在于美国市场准入：联邦牌照将使本土交易所能够上线目前主要在离岸提供的杠杆及永续类产品，涉及交易所股票、在岸永续合约场所及为其撮合交易的经纪商，而更清晰的规则也会降低银行和券商涉足加密业务的门槛。由于该文件只是开启意见征询期，近期影响限于围绕美国受监管场所的情绪与仓位，而非已生效的规则。
featured.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through US market access: a federal license would let domestic exchanges list leveraged and perpetual-style products now largely offered offshore, putting exchange equities, listed perp venues and the brokers routing those trades in scope, with clear rules also lowering the barrier for banks and brokers to touch crypto. Because the document only opens a comment period, near-term effects are confined to sentiment and positioning around US-regulated venues rather than to rules in force.

dormant.title_zh: Abracadabra 因多次黑客攻击提议清算协议并关闭 MIM
dormant.title_en: Abracadabra Proposes Winding Down MIM at Four Cents on the Dollar
dormant.latest_update_zh:
Abracadabra 已就“有序关停”协议发起治理投票，理由是一系列安全事件使其稳定币 Magic Internet Money（MIM）已“没有回到锚定价值的可行路径”。提案披露目前有 2200 万枚 MIM 未偿付，而“可动用抵押资产”仅约 90 万美元，隐含每枚 MIM 价值约 0.04 美元；截至发稿，投票约有 1 亿枚 SPELL 赞成、50 万枚反对，投票定于周三晚间结束。

该投票将正式宣告一个锁仓总值曾达 60 亿美元的协议走向终结，其披露的资产缺口意味着仍持有 MIM 的用户将面临重大损失。DeFi 评论人、Trading Strategy 联合创始人 Mikko Ohtamaa 公开将此举称为“金库掠夺”，并指向此前的 DAO 资金转移。

据文章称，该协议因 2024 年 1 月 650 万美元的黑客攻击，以及 2025 年 3 月和 10 月两起分别涉资 1300 万美元和 170 万美元的攻击，累计产生 2100 万美元坏账。Ohtamaa 指出，6 月 8 日和 11 日在 Curve 上出现了金库抛售 MIM 的操作，在“MIM 已经脱锚”的情况下为卖方换回约 50 万美元；随后的一个月又发生“金库提取”，逾 800 万美元被转入一个 Binance 充值地址和一个未标注地址。关停提案既未处理这些资金，也未在赎回计算中将其纳入。
dormant.latest_update_en: Abracadabra has moved to wind down the protocol after repeated hacks left its Magic Internet Money stablecoin with 22 million outstanding MIM against roughly $900,000 in actionable backing, prompting accusations of 'treasury looting' over earlier governance actions.
